What is the design and build quality of the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Pods?

How to use Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Prefilled Pods?
To use Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Prefilled Pods:
• Remove pod and refill container from packaging
• Peel off silicone plugs and protective seals
• Press the 2ml pod onto the 8ml refill container until it clicks
• Insert the combined unit into the Dojo Blast 10K device
• Wait 5 minutes to let e-liquid saturate the coil
Monitor e-liquid through the transparent pod section. Swap out pods when e-liquid depletes or taste diminishes.

IVG Smart Max prefilled pods are paired with a 10ml refill tank, making them a reliable alternative to disposables while keeping the vaping experience simple. Whether you are upgrading your vape kit or switching from single-use devices,

Built with advanced mesh coil technology, these IVG Smart Max 10k refill pods enhance vapour density and flavour clarity across popular IVG flavours. Why choose IVG Max Smart Vape Pods

IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod is made for vapers who want strong flavour, smooth puffs, and easy refills. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with IVG premium 20mg, 10mg nic salt e-liquid and works with a 10ml refill, giving you up to 10,000 puffs. Built with advanced mesh coil technology and compatibility with IVG Smart Max Vape Kit delivers better flavour and vapour with every puff. This vape kit also includes a 1000mAh battery and Type-C fast charging for all-day use. These IVG Smart Max Refill Pods are the best alternatives to a traditional disposable vape, the IVG Smart Max offers long-lasting use, simple refill kits, and a wide flavour range, all from one of the UK’s largest international vape brands.
How to Use IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pods
Follow the steps mentioned below for proper use:

Step 1: Remove from Packaging
Take the2ml  pod paired with the 10ml refill container out of the refill pack.

Step 2: Attach the Pod and Refill Container
Push the 2ml prefilled mesh coil pod firmly into the 10ml refill tank until it clicks into place.

Step 3: Instert Pod System in the Device
Insert both pod + refill container into the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Kit. Ensure the refill container is properly connected so it can automatically feed e-liquid into the pod.

Step 4: Start Vaping
Simply inhale to activate. The device is draw-activated, so no buttons are required.

Step 5: Replace When Empty
Once flavour or vapour drops, remove the used unit and replace it with a new IVG Smart Max replacement pod.

How to Refill Lost Mary BM6000 Pods
Getting started is a simple deal for beginners and experienced vapers:
Remove the empty pod: Slide out the used 2ml pod and empty 10ml refill container from your Lost Mary BM6000 device.
Separate components: Gently detach the pod from the refill pack.
Prep the new pod: Remove the small safety rubber from the mouthpiece of the new prefilled pod.
Attach and insert: Connect the new 10ml refill container to the device base, then insert the prefilled 2ml pod on top. You’re ready to vape.

Remove the used pod, attach a fresh 10ml refill container to the base, and insert a new prefilled 2ml pod on top. The auto‑refill system handles the rest.

Nicotine salts reach peak blood concentration faster than freebase nicotine, which explains the strong fit with recent switchers. Vapers running sub-ohm kits below 0.8Ω get a harsh draw from 20mg, so lower strengths serve those devices better.
How to Open and Fill ELFLIQ Nicotine Salts

ELFLIQ vape liquid bottles open through a child-resistant cap that releases under downward pressure, then feed a pod through the easy-fill nozzle. Priming the coil for 5 to 10 minutes before the first draw prevents a burnt wick and preserves flavour. The full process takes under two minutes.
Press the cap down. Push firmly on the child-resistant cap to release the internal lock.
Twist anticlockwise. Hold downward pressure while turning until the cap lifts clear of the bottle.
Open the fill port. Lift the silicone plug on the side or base of your pod.
Fill the pod slowly. Squeeze the nozzle gently and stop short of the maximum line to leave air space.
Seal the port. Press the silicone plug back into place and wipe away excess e-liquid.
Prime the coil. Stand the pod upright for 5 to 10 minutes so the wick absorbs the e-liquid fully.
Draw gently. Take slow mouth to lung puffs at 12W to 16W for the first few draws.

Overfilling forces e-liquid into the airway and causes gurgling, so leaving a small air gap keeps the draw clean. Replacing the coil every 7 to 14 days maintains flavour clarity across the sweeter fruit blends.

Features and specifications of Hayati Pro Ultra Plus Pods

What is the Hayati Pro Ultra Refill Pods Pod?

Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pod is a replacement pod for the Hayati Pro Ultra + 25K Pod Kit. Each box contains two 2ml pods and two 10ml refill containers. Combined e-liquid capacity is 24ml, which delivers up to 25,000 puffs.

Pods click into the Hayati Pro Ultra + 25K device magnetically. Refill containers attach to the pods and automatically feed e-liquid as you vape. Rotating the mouthpiece switches between the two flavours.
E-liquid inside is nicotine salt at 20mg/ml. Internal mesh coils distribute heat evenly across the e-liquid. Hayati 25K Pods comply with UK TRPR regulations.

How to use the Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pod?

• Draw on the mouthpiece to start vaping
Rotate the mouthpiece to alternate between flavours. Swap out pods when e-liquid depletes or taste fades.
What is the price of the Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods?

Why should you buy Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Pods?

Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods provide 25,000 puffs per box across two flavours. The 24ml combined e-liquid capacity outlasts standard replacement pods by a significant margin. Rotating the mouthpiece alternates between flavours without any pod removal.
Internal mesh coils heat e-liquid uniformly, maintaining flavour quality until the pod empties. Magnetic pod connections hold firmly during use. Sealed construction prevents e-liquid from escaping.
Hayati 25K Pods meet UK TRPR requirements: 2ml pod size, 10ml refill container size, and 20mg/ml nicotine concentration.
How many puffs do Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Refill Pods offer?
Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods deliver up to 25,000 puffs per box. Puff count varies based on draw length, frequency, and vaping habits.
How much nicotine is in Hayati Pro Ultra + Pods?

Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods contain 20mg/ml nicotine in salt form, equal to 2% concentration. Salt-based nicotine enters the bloodstream quicker than freebase and produces less throat irritation at higher levels. 20mg/ml is the UK legal ceiling under TRPR.
Which device is compatible with the Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pod?
Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods fit the Hayati Pro Ultra + 25K Pod Kit exclusively. Pod dimensions and magnetic fittings match only this device. Other vape kits cannot accept these pods.
How does the dual-flavour system work in Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods?
The dual-flavour system separates two e-liquid chambers with independent mesh coils. Each chamber holds a distinct flavour. No mixing occurs between chambers.
Rotating the mouthpiece redirects airflow to the alternate chamber. Flavour changes happen instantly mid-session.
Are Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods reusable or disposable?

Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods are single-use and non-refillable. Dispose of empty pods and insert fresh ones. The Hayati Pro Ultra + 25K device itself recharges and accepts new pods repeatedly.
Is the Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pod system leak-proof?
Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods feature sealed construction with magnetic fittings that contain e-liquid during use and storage. No spillage occurs under normal conditions.
How does the twist-to-switch feature work in Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Prefilled Pods?
Twist-to-switch allows mid-session flavour changes without pod removal. Turn the mouthpiece to route airflow through the alternate chamber. Each chamber operates independently with its own coil.

column1: Here is the step-by-step guide on how to use the Dojo Blast 6000 Prefilled Vape Pods:
• Remove the silicone plug on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod and the sticker on the bottom.
• Insert the 2ml prefilled pod into the 10ml refill container smoothly until it is assembled in place.
• Ensure the 2ml prefilled pod and the 10ml refill container are connected properly.
• Press to switch between Turbo Mode and Normal Mode for your preferred vaping experience.
How long does a Dojo Blast 6000 pod last?
Each Dojo Blast 6000 pod offers up to 6000 puffs, depending on usage. This provides an extended vaping experience compared to regular disposable pods.
How do I refill the Dojo Blast 6000 pod?

Simply follow the steps: remove the silicone plug and sticker from the 2ml pod, insert the pod into the 10ml refill container, and ensure they are properly connected before inserting them into the device.
Can I use any e-liquid with the Dojo Blast 6000 pods?
These pods are prefilled with nicotine salt e-liquid in 20mg (2%) or 10mg (1%) strength. It is recommended to use the prefilled pods for the best performance and flavour.
What flavours are available for the Dojo Blast 6000 pods?
The Dojo Blast 6000 pods come in 21 different flavours, including fruity options like Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice and unique blends like Breakfast Tea.
Can I switch between Turbo Mode and Normal Mode?
Yes, you can press the button on the device to switch between Turbo Mode and Normal Mode based on your preference for either a more intense or regular vaping experience.
Are the Dojo Blast 6000 pods compatible with other devices?
The Dojo Blast 6000 pods are designed specifically for use with the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 6000 pod vape kit. For optimal performance, it’s recommended to use them with a compatible device.
How do I know when the pod is empty?
When the flavour starts to degrade or the draw feels weak, it may indicate that the pod is running low on e-liquid. At that point, it’s time to replace or refill the pod.
Are the Dojo Blast 6000 pods safe to use?

Yes, these pods are made with high-quality materials and advanced technology from Vaporesso, ensuring a safe and enjoyable vaping experience when used as intended. Always follow safety instructions provided with the product.

column1: Bar Juice 5000 nic salts are available in 5mg/ml, 10mg/ml and 20mg/ml nicotine strengths. All three come in 10ml bottles and use a nicotine salt formulation. The strength describes the nicotine concentration, while the bottle size stays the same.

Bar Juice 5000 5mg is the lowest nicotine strength in the range, containing 5mg, equivalent to 0.5%. It comes in a 10ml bottle and uses a nicotine salt formulation. Bar Juice 5000 10mg contains 10mg, equivalent to 1%. It sits between the 5mg and 20mg options in the range and comes in the same 10ml bottle format. The nicotine concentration is twice that of the 5mg version and half that of the 20mg version, while the formulation remains nicotine salt.

Bar Juice 5000 20mg is the highest nicotine strength in the range, containing 20mg, equivalent to 2%. Each 10ml bottle uses a nicotine salt formulation. This version has twice the nicotine concentration of the 10mg option. The strength describes nicotine content rather than flavour intensity, and the amount absorbed during use depends on the device and usage.
Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salt E-liquid Device Compatibility

Bar Juice 5000 e-liquid is intended for compatible refillable mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits. Its stated 50/50 VG/PG formulation is paired with guidance for low-wattage devices. Compatibility depends on the specific pod and coil, so check whether the device manufacturer supports this e-liquid ratio and nicotine formulation. Closed, prefilled pods should not be opened or refilled unless expressly designed for that purpose.

The recommend 0.6Ω to 1.4Ω coils and power settings of 30W or less. However, 30W is not a suitable setting for every coil within that resistance range. Follow the wattage range printed on the coil or stated in the device manual. Resistance alone does not determine compatibility, and the coil’s rated maximum should never be exceeded.
Follow the mentioned below steps to use Bar Juice 5000 Vape Juice:
Open the filling port: Follow your pod’s instructions to locate the correct opening.
Fill the pod carefully: Add the liquid through the filling port, avoiding the central airflow tube and leaving space to prevent overfilling.
Close it securely: Reseal the filling port and wipe away any spills.
Allow a new coil to soak: Wait for the priming time before using it.
Check the power setting: If your device has adjustable wattage, stay within the cartridge’s stated range.
Monitor the liquid level: Refill before the pod runs dry, and stop using it if you notice a burnt taste.

column1: COREX 2.0 vs COREX 3.0: What's the Difference?

The main difference between Vaporesso XROS Corex 2.0 and Corex 3.0 is the coil structure. Corex 2.0 runs an optimised morph-mesh grid for fast heating and full-bodied taste. Corex 3.0 introduces a Hive Mesh structure, a chimney airflow channel, and aerospace-grade materials for a sharper, more precise flavour.
Both versions share the same 2ml capacity, the same five resistances, and the same SSS leak resistance, so the choice comes down to flavour preference.

Corex 3.0 sharpens individual flavour notes and runs a slightly longer pod life, while Corex 2.0 pushes a fuller, faster hit. Vapers chasing flavour clarity and smoother draws choose 3.0, because the Hive Mesh and redesigned chimney airway lift aroma detail and cut condensation. Vapers wanting a warm, punchy taste stay on 2.0.
Vaporesso XROS Corex Pod Resistance Options

Vaporesso XROS Corex pods arrive in five resistances, each tuned to a wattage and a draw style. Lower resistances open the draw for RDL and DTL vaping. Higher resistances tighten the draw for a mouth-to-lung inhale.

The 0.4Ω pod draws more power than the rest, so device compatibility narrows to higher-output XROS kits. Compatibility across each XROS model sits in the next section.

Why Choose Vaporesso XROS Corex Pods

Vaporesso XROS Corex pods heat e-liquid through a mesh coil that spreads contact evenly across the wick. Even contact lifts flavour clarity and cuts the dry, burnt notes of uneven coils. Corex 3.0 adds a Hive Mesh structure and chimney airflow for extra aroma detail.

The upgraded build extends pod life by up to 30% over the original XROS pods. Whether a vaper runs sweet fruit blends or menthol nic salts, the mesh holds a consistent taste from first refill to last. Practical for daily vaping without frequent pod swaps.

Vaporesso XROS Corex pods seal e-liquid with SSS leak-resistant technology built into the pod base. The seal locks liquid inside during transport and pocket carry. A clamshell top-fill cap opens with one hand for a quick refill.

Refilling takes seconds, because the fill port sits under the mouthpiece rather than the base. Whether topping up at home or on the move, the design keeps e-liquid off the fingers and out of the airflow. Ideal for vapers who refill on the go.

Vaporesso XROS Corex pods run both freebase and nic salt e-liquids across all five resistances. Higher-resistance 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, and 1.2Ω pods pair with nic salts for a smooth mouth-to-lung draw. Lower-resistance 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω pods suit high-VG freebase for a warmer, fuller vapour.

The range covers tight MTL inhales through to open RDL and DTL hits from one pod family. Whether a vaper wants a cigarette-style draw or a cloud-forward exhale, a matching resistance sits in the pack. Ideal for vapers refining a preferred vaping style.
How to Refill the Vaporesso XROS Corex Pod

Refilling the Vaporesso XROS Corex pod follows a simple top-fill process. Remove the mouthpiece, add e-liquid, reseat the cap, then prime the coil. The full refill takes under a minute, with a two-minute soak for new pods.
Remove the mouthpiece. Pull the mouthpiece off the pod to expose the top-fill port.
Fill the pod. Insert the e-liquid nozzle into the port and fill to the 2ml line without overfilling.
Reseat the mouthpiece. Press the mouthpiece back until it clicks into place and seals the port.
Prime the coil. Wait two minutes for the coil to absorb e-liquid before the first draw, because a dry coil burns the wick.

Vaporesso Xros 3 Pod Vape Kit

The Vaporesso XROS 3 Pod Kit is a sleek and powerful vape kit made for both new and experienced vapers. Built with a strong 1000mAh battery, this device offers excellent battery life and supports fast recharging. The XROS 3 vape uses refillable pods from the popular XROS series, each holding 2ml of your favourite e-liquid or nic salt.

Thanks to its advanced Corex heating technology and mesh pods, you get fast, even heating and great flavour without the risk of a burnt taste. The built-in Axon chip and pulse mode help deliver steady power and smoother vapor. The adjustable airflow gives you the freedom to enjoy either a tight MTL (mouth-to-lung) or relaxed RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) draw.

The Vaporesso XROS 3 pod is easy to use, leak-resistant, and perfect for those moving from disposable vapes. It is available in stylish colours like Space Grey, Neon Sunset, and Mint Green. Whether you prefer nicotine salt or regular vape juice, this pod system delivers a top-quality vaping experience every time.
Vaporesso Xros 3 Refillable Vape Kit Key Features
• Compatible with Nic Salt and Freebase E-liquids
How to Use Vaporesso Xros 3 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
Charge the Device: The new Vaporesso XROS 3 comes with an integrated 1000mAh battery. Use the Type-C cable to fully charge your pod device before use.

Choose Your Pod: The kit includes two pods, a 0.6Ω mesh pod for RDTL vaping, and a 1.0 ohm pod for a tighter MTL vape.
Both are compatible with all XROS pods, including other options from the XROS family.

Fill with E-Liquid: Remove the pod to reveal the top-fill port. Fill with your favourite nic salt vape juice or freebase e-liquid.
Wait 5 minutes to let the vape coils soak the liquid fully.
Attach and Vape: Snap the pod back in. The XROS 3 pod vape kit supports auto-draw or button fire, just inhale or press to vape. Adjust the airflow slider to switch between MTL and RDTL vaping modes.
Refill or Replace Pods: When flavour fades or vapour reduces, refill the pod or replace it. The pods last long but are not disposable pods they are refillable and reusable.
What type of pods does the Vaporesso XROS 3 use?
The XROS 3 pod vape kit is compatible with all XROS pods, including the 0.6Ω mesh pod for RDTL vaping and the 1.0 ohm pod for a smoother MTL vape.
How long do the pods of Vaporesso Xros 3 rechargeable pod kit last?
With proper care, the XROS 3 pods last around 1 to 2 weeks depending on usage and e-liquid type. Avoid chain vaping to extend pod life.
Can I use nic salts with Vaporesso Xros 3 Pod kit?
Yes! The Vaporesso XROS 3 pod vape works great as a nic salt vape device, providing a smooth and satisfying hit with 20mg or lower nicotine strengths.
Is the battery of Vaporesso Xros 3 Kit rechargeable?
Yes. The XROS 3 kit features an integrated 1000mAh battery with Type-C fast charging for long battery life and quick top-ups.
Is the XROS 3 Vape easy to use for beginners?
Definitely. It is an easy-to-use pod device, just fill the pod, let it sit for a few minutes, and inhale to vape. No buttons required unless preferred.
Can I switch between MTL and RDTL?
Yes, the XROS 3 is compatible with both MTL and RDTL vaping thanks to its adjustable airflow and dual-pod options.
Is the XROS 3 better than disposable pods?
Yes. It offers a more customisable and eco-friendly alternative to disposable pods, with refillable options and better performance.
Thanks to leak-resistant technology, the XROS pods offer a clean and mess-free vaping experience with the Vaporesso XROS 3 Vape.
Is the XROS 3 part of the XROS family?

Yes, it belongs to the popular XROS family and works seamlessly with any pod from the XROS range, including those from XROS Pro and XROS Mini.

column1: Just Juice Nic Salt E-liquid comes in 3 nicotine strengths, giving you more control over your vaping experience than brands limited to 2 options. All 3 strengths use the same refined salt nicotine base for smooth absorption, clean throat feel, and consistent flavour delivery.

The 5mg strength is the lightest option in the Just Juice Nic Salt range. This strength delivers a minimal throat hit with maximum flavour clarity on every draw. 5mg nic salt suits vapers who have already reduced their nicotine intake and prefer a near-zero throat sensation during relaxed, casual vaping sessions.

Choose 5mg for social vaping, flavour-focused sessions, or as the final step in a gradual nicotine reduction plan. This strength works best for light vapers, flavour chasers, and anyone stepping down from 10mg who wants to maintain the vaping habit with minimal nicotine intake.

The 10mg strength sits at the mid-level of the Just Juice Eliquid range. This strength delivers a noticeable but comfortable throat hit that balances flavour enjoyment with steady nicotine satisfaction. 10mg nic salt suits vapers who vape regularly throughout the day without needing a strong nicotine punch on every draw.

Choose 10mg for consistent all-day vaping at a controlled intensity. This strength works best for light-to-moderate smokers making the switch, vapers stepping down from 20mg, and anyone who finds 5mg too subtle and 20mg too firm.

The 20mg strength is the strongest option in the Just Juice Bar Nic Salt range. This strength delivers a firm, direct throat hit that replicates the nicotine intensity of a traditional cigarette and most disposable bars. 20mg nic salt suits heavy vapers and recent smokers who need rapid, strong nicotine delivery to stay off cigarettes.

Choose 20mg as your starting strength after quitting smoking or switching from disposable vapes. This strength works best for 10+ cigarettes-a-day smokers, disposable users accustomed to 20mg devices, and anyone who needs maximum craving relief from fewer puffs throughout the day.
Which Devices Work Best with Just Juice Vape Salts?

Just Juice Nic Salt performs best in refillable MTL pod kits and pen vapes with coils rated 0.8Ω and above, operating at 10 to 15W. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures smooth wicking, consistent flavour, and reliable vapour production across a wide range of MTL devices. Using sub-ohm devices above 30W with Just Juice nic salts is not recommended because higher wattage creates a harsh throat hit and increases nicotine consumption beyond comfortable levels.
How to Use Just Juice 10ml Nic Salt E-liquids
Getting the best flavour and coil life from Just Juice 10ml Nic Salt takes 4 simple steps. Follow this guide to ensure a smooth, satisfying vape from the moment you fill your pod.

Select 5mg for light vaping, 10mg for a moderate daily hit, or 20mg for strong craving relief. Matching your strength to your nicotine needs prevents overconsumption and ensures a comfortable throat hit on every draw.

Apply 3 to 4 drops of Just Juice Vape Liquid directly onto the exposed cotton wicking of your coil. Priming saturates the cotton before your first draw, preventing dry hits, burnt taste, and premature coil damage.

Open the fill port and pour Just Juice Nicotine Salt into the pod chamber at a steady pace. Leave a small gap at the top to prevent overflow and leaking. Seal the fill port firmly and wipe any excess liquid from the outside of the pod.

Insert the pod back into your device and wait 5 minutes for the coil to absorb the e-liquid fully. Take 2 to 3 gentle primer puffs without firing the device to pull liquid deeper into the cotton. Inhale with a slow, steady MTL draw to start vaping with full flavour clarity.

Vaporesso Luxe X and XR Replacement Mesh Pods

Luxe X Replacement Pods are the perfect balance of performance and convenience, come with a huge list of up-scaled features and are expertly designed for the Luxe X and Luxe XR Max devices. These high-quality replacement pods are available in two options: built-in mesh coil pods for quick, mess-free replacements, and empty pod versions compatible with Vaporesso GTX coils for more customisation and cost efficiency. With multiple resistance levels and support for MTL (Mouth To Lung), RDTL (Restricted Direct To Lung), and DTL (Direct To Lung) vaping, these pods are ideal for all vaping preferences.

These prefilled pods feature the trusted SSS anti-leak technology, each 2ml pod ensures a classic and safe design which seals to prevent leaks and enhances flavour. The convenient bottom-fill system makes refilling smooth and easy, while the mesh coil design guarantees fast heating, rich flavour, and satisfying vapour production. Choose between 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, and 0.8Ω coil options to suit your favourite e-liquids, you can also use balanced 50/50 mixes or nicotine salts for a smoother MTL experience. The&
column3: fixed wattage makes them ideal for both beginners and seasoned vapers.

column1: How to Use Vaporesso Luxe X and XR Replacement Pods
Choose your pod type: Pick either a pod with a built-in coil or an empty pod for GTX coils.
Fill the pod: Pull out the pod, open the rubber stopper at the bottom, and fill with your preferred e-liquid.
Wait before use: If it is a new pod, let it sit for 5 to 10 minutes so the coil fully absorbs the liquid.
Insert the pod: Push the filled pod back into your Luxe X device until it clicks in place.
Start Vape: The device auto-adjusts the wattage. Just inhale and enjoy.
FAQs About Luxe X and XR Mesh Pods
What devices are Vaporesso Luxe X Mesh Pods compatible with?
These pods work with the Vaporesso Luxe X, Luxe XR, Luxe XR Max, and Luxe X Pro.
What e-liquids should I use with these pods?
You can use the e-liquids which suit you the most, whether it is 50/50 e-liquid, 70VG/30PG or nic salts.
How do I fill the Luxe X pod?
Remove the pod from the device, open the bottom rubber stopper, and fill with e-liquid. Close the stopper securely before reinserting the pod.
How long does a Luxe X pod last?
Typically, a pod lasts 5 to 10 days, depending on usage, e-liquid type, and coil resistance.
Does the  Luxe X  and XR pod leak?
No. Luxe X Pods feature SSS anti-leak technology to prevent leaks and maintain clean performance.

Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini Vape Kit

A 50% VG ratio sits as the recommended e-liquid blend across the Corex pods.

A coloured LED indicator on the device body tracks the remaining battery level at a glance. An adjustable airflow slider tightens or loosens the inhale to taste, covering tight MTL through to looser RDTL draws on one kit.

How to Use Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini Pod Kit

Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini takes five steps, fill the Corex pod, insert it into the kit, prime the coil, inhale to vape, then adjust modes and airflow to taste. The kit fires on inhale activation alone, with no buttons or settings to configure.
Fill the Corex Pod: Lift the mouthpiece off the 0.6Ω Corex pod, fill the 2ml chamber with your chosen e-liquid, then refit the mouthpiece.
Insert the Pod: Slide the filled Corex pod into Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini until it seats with a magnetic click.
Prime the Coil: Leave the kit to stand for 10 minutes so the e-liquid soaks into the mesh coil.
Inhale to Vape: Draw on the mouthpiece to fire the coil, Xros 6 Mini runs on inhale activation, with no button press needed.
Adjust Modes and Airflow: Take two quick puffs on the mouthpiece to switch between Eco Mode and Power Mode, then slide the airflow control to tighten or loosen the draw.
Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini kit ships with three items inside the box, the device, a Corex pod and a user manual. Each item covers a stage of setup, from Xros 6 Mini device to the printed guide.

How long does Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini battery last?

The 1600mAh battery lasts most vapers a full day of MTL or RDTL vaping on a single charge. Battery life varies with wattage and draw length, because higher-output Corex pods draw more power per puff. USB-C charging refills the Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini battery to full in 57 minutes.
Which pods work with Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini Kit?

How do I switch modes on Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini Pod Kit?

Take two quick puffs on the mouthpiece to switch between Eco Mode and Power Mode on the Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini. Eco Mode conserves the battery for longer sessions, and Power Mode lifts output for bolder flavour. No buttons run the mode switch on the Xros 6 Mini.
What is the difference between Vaporesso Xros 6 and  Xros 6 Mini?

The main differences sit in battery size, display and activation. Vaporesso Xros 6 carries an 1800mAh battery, a 0.88-inch TFT screen and dual button-plus-inhale activation. Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini runs a compact 1600mAh build with an LED indicator and inhale activation only.
Is Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini suitable for beginners?

Yes, Vaporesso Xros 6 Mini suits beginners and experienced vapers alike. Inhale activation runs the kit without buttons, because the coil fires on draw across both power modes. Refilling stays simple through the top-fill 2ml pod and the full Corex pod range.

A burnt taste from a new Elux Legend 8000 pod points to a coil fired before the wick soaked through. Rest the assembled pack upright for three to five minutes after fitting. Chain vaping produces the same result mid-pack, so leave a few seconds between draws.

column1: How to Use Crystal Higo BB 4000 Refill Pods
Mentioned below are the easy steps to set up your Higo 4k pods properly:
Take out the 2 ml pod. Remove any plugs, seals, or stickers before use.

Align the container with the base of the device and press it on so it sits straight and secure.

Fill the pod with e-liquid, insert it into your Geekvape Q series device, and inhale to vape. The entire process takes under 2 minutes with zero coil changes or manual settings.

Step 1: Remove the Pod from Packaging
Take one Geekvape Q Pod Cartridge from the 3-pack. Remove any protective seals covering the pod contacts and mouthpiece.

Step 2: Fill the Pod
For top-fill pods, snap off the mouthpiece cap, squeeze e-liquid into the fill port, and snap the cap firmly back in place. For side-fill pods, peel the silicone plug, fill to the line, and push the plug back in. Avoid overfilling past the maximum line to prevent leaking and flooding.

Step 3: Wait for Coil Saturation
Allow 3 to 5 minutes for the built-in mesh coil to fully absorb the e-liquid. Skipping the wait period increases the risk of a dry hit on the first draw and reduces coil lifespan.

Step 4: Insert into the Device
Slide the pod into your Geekvape Q series kit until it clicks into place. The device detects the pod automatically with no buttons or settings required.

Step 5: Inhale to Vape
Draw from the mouthpiece to activate the device. Geekvape Q Pod Cartridges use draw activation, no fire button required. Higher resistance pods (0.8Ω–1.2Ω) deliver a tight MTL draw, and lower resistance pods (0.4Ω–0.6Ω) produce an airier RDTL draw.

Step 6: Refill or Replace When Needed
Top up the pod through the top-fill or side-fill port when e-liquid runs low. Replace the entire pod cartridge when flavour quality degrades or vapour production weakens, the built-in coil eliminates separate coil changes.

Top-fill pods snap open at the mouthpiece for refilling. Side-fill pods use a silicone plug with colour-coded resistances, Red (0.4Ω), Orange (0.6Ω), Light Green (0.8Ω), and Green (1.2Ω). Both filling types hold 2ml of e-liquid and use built-in mesh coils.

Higher resistance pods (0.8Ω to 1.2Ω) perform best with 50/50 freebase and nic salt e-liquids for MTL vaping. Lower resistance pods (0.4Ω to 0.6Ω) perform best with 70% VG e-liquids for RDTL vaping. Both freebase and nic salt blends work well across all resistances.
Geekvape Q Pod Cartridges hold 2ml of e-liquid per pod cartridge. Both top-fill and side-fill options share the same 2ml capacity.
How many pods come in a pack of Geekvape Q Pods?

How to Open and Refill a Pod With PIXL E-liquid

Refilling a pod kit with PIXL Nic Salts takes under a minute. The bottle uses a child resistant cap that releases by pressing down and turning anticlockwise, and the narrow nozzle fits standard pod fill ports. Priming a fresh coil before the first draw prevents a burnt taste.
Open the child resistant cap. Press the cap down firmly, then turn anticlockwise until the thread releases.
Remove the pod. Pull the pod straight out of the battery section of the device.
Open the fill port. Lift the silicone bung on the side or base of the pod.
Insert the nozzle. Place the bottle nozzle into the fill port and squeeze slowly to avoid air pockets.
Fill to the maximum line. Stop at the 2ml fill mark, because overfilling floods the coil and causes leaking.
Seal the fill port. Press the bung back into place until the surface sits flush.
Prime the coil. Wait five minutes before the first draw so the wick absorbs e-liquid fully.
Reseal the bottle. Press the cap down and turn clockwise until the thread clicks into the locked position.

How much nicotine is in a PIXL nic salt bottle?

Which PIXL nic salt strength suits your smoking habit?

20mg/ml suits heavier smokers of 15 or more cigarettes a day, matching the nicotine intensity of a prefilled pod. 10mg/ml suits light and moderate smokers who want a gentler draw across a full day. Start at 20mg/ml and step down as cravings reduce.
Which vape kits work with PIXL Nic Salts?

PIXL Nic Salts work with refillable pod kits and MTL starter kits running coils between 0.6Ω and 1.2Ω. Devices including the Vaporesso XROS series, OXVA Xlim Pro 2, and Uwell Caliburn G3 vaporise a 50/50 blend cleanly at 8W to 15W. Sub ohm kits below 0.6Ω produce too much vapour for a 20mg/ml salt.
Are PIXL Nic Salts stronger than freebase e-liquid?

No, PIXL Nic Salts carry the same milligram strength as freebase e-liquid at the same label figure. Benzoic acid lowers the pH of the salt formula, which softens the throat feel and speeds nicotine absorption. Higher strengths therefore inhale smoother despite identical nicotine content.

Uwell Caliburn GPP pods come in 4 coil resistances, and each one shapes airflow, wattage and e-liquid pairing differently. Pick the resistance that matches your preferred draw and nicotine strength:
0.4Ω GPP pod delivers a warm RDTL vape at 25 to 30W, best paired with higher-VG e-liquid for fuller vapour.
0.6Ω GPP pod sits between RDTL and loose MTL at 18 to 23W, giving a balance of flavour and vapour with 50/50 freebase e-liquid or nic salts.
0.9Ω GPP pod runs a smooth MTL draw at 12 to 16W, ideal for 10mg or 20mg nic salt e-liquid.
1.2Ω GPP pod gives the tightest cigarette-style MTL inhale at 10 to 13W, tuned for 20mg nic salts and clean flavour clarity.
Flipping any Uwell Caliburn GPP pod 180 degrees inside the kit tightens or loosens the airflow further, so four resistances translate into eight distinct draw combinations.

column1: Who Should Use the Uwell Caliburn GPP Replacement Pods?
Uwell Caliburn GPP pods suit Caliburn owners who want one shared cartridge across the G3, G4 and G5 kits. The pod is a strong fit for:
• Adult smokers looking for a rechargeable alternative to single-use vapes with a familiar MTL draw.
• Existing Caliburn G3 users upgrading to the GPP platform with wider cross-compatibility.
• Caliburn G4 vapers, including Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro and Uwell Caliburn G4 Mini users, who want mesh-coil pods with cleaner refilling.
• Nic salt users pairing 20mg e-liquid with the 0.9Ω or 1.2Ω resistance for a tighter cigarette-style inhale.
• RDTL vapers running 0.4Ω or 0.6Ω pods for warmer vapour and richer flavour.

Each user group benefits from the same PRO-FOCS 4.0 flavour delivery and U² anti-leak build, so the Uwell Caliburn GPP pod scales from a first refillable step to a daily driver without hardware changes.
How to Fill the Uwell Caliburn GPP Replacement Pods

Filling the Uwell Caliburn GPP pod takes under a minute and depends on the resistance: the 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω and 0.9Ω pods use a side-fill port, and the 1.2Ω pod uses a top-fill port. Follow the steps below to prime a fresh Uwell Caliburn GPP replacement pod cartridge before first use.
Remove the pod from the kit. Pull the Uwell Caliburn GPP pod straight up from the Caliburn G3, G4 or G5 device to release the magnetic connection.
Open the refill port. Peel back the side silicone plug on 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω and 0.9Ω pods, or lift the top mouthpiece cap on the 1.2Ω pod.
Fill with e-liquid. Insert the e-liquid bottle nozzle and fill to the 2ml line with nic salt or 50/50 freebase e-liquid.
Reseal the port. Press the silicone plug flush or click the mouthpiece cap back into place to keep the pod airtight.
Prime the mesh coil. Stand the pod upright for 5 to 10 minutes so the e-liquid saturates the mesh coil evenly.
Reattach the pod. Push the Uwell Caliburn GPP pod back into the device until the magnets click into position.
Adjust the airflow. Flip the pod 180 degrees inside the kit to tighten or loosen the draw.
Draw or fire. Inhale through the mouthpiece, or press the fire button if your Caliburn model has one.
Priming the mesh coil correctly protects the Uwell Caliburn GPP pod from dry hits and extends the cartridge's flavour life across the full 2ml of e-liquid.

What are the Uwell Caliburn GPP pods?

Uwell Caliburn GPP pods are refillable 2ml replacement cartridges built on Uwell's G Pod Platform, with a built-in mesh coil, PRO-FOCS 4.0 flavour tech and U² anti-leak construction. Each Uwell Caliburn GPP replacement pod fits the Caliburn G3, G4 and G5 series and comes in 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.9Ω and 1.2Ω resistances for MTL and RDTL vaping.
Which Caliburn kits are compatible with the Uwell Caliburn GPP pods?

Uwell Caliburn GPP pods are compatible with the full Caliburn G3, G4 and G5 series, including the G3, G3 Lite, G3 Pro, G3 Pro KOKO, G4, G4 Pro, G4 Classic, G4 Mini and supported G5 kits. The G Pod Platform uses one shared cartridge across every kit in the range, and the full Uwell Caliburn pods range covers every resistance in stock.
Do Uwell Caliburn G3 pods fit the Caliburn G4?

Yes, Uwell Caliburn G3 pods fit the Caliburn G4 because the GPP platform is shared across the G3, G4 and G5 generations. The Uwell Caliburn GPP replacement pod has superseded the original Caliburn G3 pod, and the new cartridge slots into any G3, G4 or G5 kit through the same magnetic connection.
Which Uwell Caliburn GPP pod resistance is best for nic salts?

The 0.9Ω and 1.2Ω Uwell Caliburn GPP pods are best for nic salts. Both resistances run low wattage between 10 and 16W, deliver a tight MTL draw, and pair cleanly with 10mg or 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction.
Do Uwell Caliburn GPP pods have replaceable coils?

No, Uwell Caliburn GPP pods have built-in mesh coils sealed inside the cartridge. When the flavour weakens, the vapour drops or the pod tastes burnt, the whole Uwell Caliburn GPP replacement pod is swapped out, which removes the need for separate coil changes.
How long does an Uwell Caliburn GPP pod last?

An Uwell Caliburn GPP pod lasts 1 to 2 weeks for an average daily vaper, depending on wattage, e-liquid sweetener content and how often the pod is refilled. Sweeter e-liquid coats the mesh coil faster, so a lower-sweetener 50/50 freebase or nic salt extends the pod's flavour lifespan.
Difference Between Uwell GPP and GPP Alpha Pods?

The Uwell Caliburn GPP Alpha pod is a newer variant of the same G Pod Platform cartridge, built with the longer-lasting AlphaCore mesh coil. Both pods share the 2ml TRPR capacity, magnetic fit and cross-compatibility with the Caliburn G3, G4 and G5 kits, and both take nic salt and 50/50 freebase e-liquid.

Vape Connect stocks genuine Uwell Caliburn GPP replacement pods and the full Uwell vape brand range in every resistance, backed by fast UK delivery, competitive pricing and secure checkout. column1: IVG Pro Salts are a UK-made nic salt e-liquid range, built on the best-selling flavours from the IVG prefilled pod catalogue. Each 10ml bottle holds a salt nicotine blend in 10mg or 20mg, paired with a 50% VG ratio for a smooth throat hit and fast craving satisfaction.

IVG Pro Salts range covers fruit, ice, menthol and sweet profiles drawn straight from IVG prefilled pod line, bringing pod-style flavours into a refillable format. The 50% VG concentration pairs cleanly with refillable MTL kits, so vapers running an MTL pod system can match pod-kit flavour at a lower running cost with this IVG Nic Salt Range.
IVG Pro Salts range pairs UK-made nic salt e-liquid with the balanced nic salt strength options and variety of flavours. 6 core features are given below:
• Nicotine salt formula for a smooth throat hit
Explore All 22 IVG Pro Salt Flavours
IVG Pro Salts offer a varied selection of fruit, ice, mint, candy and drink-inspired blends. Browse all available flavours in the range below.
Following are the main reasons to choose IVG Pro Salts:

IVG Pro Salts range is built on the best-selling flavours from the IVG prefilled pod category, bringing pod-style taste into a refillable 10ml format. Each blend mimics a flavour profile already proven across the IVG pod range, so vapers swapping from a prefilled kit to a refillable setup keep the same taste at a lower running cost.

The flavour range covers fruit, ice, menthol and sweet profiles across the collection, drawn directly from IVG's most popular pod blends. Whether replicating a favourite pod flavour or trying a new one, IVG Pro Nic Salts range delivers a familiar taste in every 10ml bottle.

IVG Pro Salts e-liquids run a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, designed specifically for refillable MTL pod kits. The balanced ratio gives strong flavour delivery and a tight mouth-to-lung draw, with enough VG to produce a small amount of vapour and enough PG to carry the flavour cleanly across the coil.

The 50/50 blend pairs with the full range of UK MTL kits, including Vaporesso Xros, Uwell Caliburn and OXVA Xlim ranges, along with most other refillable pod systems running between 10 and 20 watts. The wick-friendly viscosity keeps absorption fast and dry hits rare.

Each IVG Pro Salts flavour comes in 10mg and 20mg nicotine salt strengths, giving the option to step up or step down across the range. Salt nicotine absorbs faster than freebase, so even at 20mg the throat hit stays smooth and craving satisfaction lands within seconds of the first draw.

The dual-strength setup suits both heavier vapers needing the 20mg hit and lighter users who prefer the 10mg blend across the day. Every Pro Salts bottle is TPD-compliant under UK e-liquid regulations and ready to drop into a refillable kit straight out of the box.
How to Use IVG Pro Salts E-Liquid

Setting up an IVG Pro Salts bottle in a refillable MTL kit takes four quick steps, open the pod, fill with the e-liquid, let the coil prime, then inhale to vape. The bottle comes ready to use straight from the pack.
Open the Pod: Remove the empty pod from the MTL kit and lift the silicone fill plug or unscrew the fill cap, depending on the device.
Fill the Pod: Drip the IVG Pro Salts e-liquid into the fill port until the pod sits at full capacity, then re-seal the cap or plug.
Prime the Coil: Leave the pod to stand for five to ten minutes so the e-liquid soaks into the coil, preventing dry hits on the first puff.
Inhale to Vape: Slot the pod back into the kit and inhale on the mouthpiece, every refillable MTL kit fires on draw or with a button, depending on the device.

column1: Which Coil Resistance Suits Your Vaping Style?

Vaporesso Eco Nano refill pods arrive in three coil resistances, and the correct rating depends on your preferred inhale style. Ohm rating shapes throat hit, vapour density, and flavour intensity from the first draw of every refilled pod.
Adult vapers pick from the three resistance options below, each tuned to a specific draw profile and e-liquid pairing.
0.6Ω Lush Mesh: delivers a restricted DTL draw with warm vapour and rich flavour, paired with 10mg nic salts or 50/50 freebase e-liquid at 18W to 25W.
0.8Ω Mesh: balances flavour depth and throat hit for a standard MTL inhale, suited to 10mg or 20mg nic salts at 12W to 18W.

Who Should Use the Vaporesso Eco Nano Vape Pods?

Vaporesso Eco Nano pods suit adult vapers running the Eco Nano range and adult smokers switching from disposable devices to a refillable pod system. Four user groups gain the most from the COREX mesh coil and SSS leak-resistant seal.
• Adult smokers transitioning from disposable vape devices to a compliant, rechargeable pod system
• MTL vapers seeking a tight, cigarette-style draw on the 1.2Ω mesh pod
• Restricted DTL vapers wanting warmer vapour and richer flavour on the 0.6Ω Lush Mesh
• Existing Vaporesso Eco Nano Kit owners replacing worn pods with fresh mesh coils

Nic salts absorb into the bloodstream faster than freebase nicotine because benzoic acid lowers the pH of the solution. Faster absorption satisfies cigarette cravings quickly for former smokers using 20mg nic salt with the 1.2Ω pod.
How to Fill and Install a Vaporesso Eco Nano Pod
Fill and install a Vaporesso Eco Nano pod in seven quick steps. Follow the sequence below to prime the mesh coil correctly and avoid dry hits during the first draws of every fresh pod refill.
Remove the pod: pull the pod upward from the device chassis to release the magnetic connection.
Open the fill port: lift the silicone stopper on the base of the pod to expose the fill hole.
Add e-liquid: insert the nozzle of a 10ml TRPR bottle and dispense up to 2ml of nic salt or 50/50 freebase e-liquid.
Seal the port: press the silicone stopper firmly back into place until flush with the pod base.
Prime the coil: wait 3 to 5 minutes for the cotton to absorb e-liquid before the first draw.
Reinstall the pod: align the pod with the device chassis and push down until the magnets click into position.
Take the first draw: inhale gently through the mouthpiece to activate the mesh coil and confirm flavour delivery.
Priming protects the mesh coil from scorching on the first draw. Skipping the wait step burns cotton before saturation, shortening pod lifespan and dulling flavour clarity across the first refill.

Do Vaporesso Eco Nano pods fit the Eco Nano Pro?

What coil resistance suits nic salt e-liquid?

The 0.8Ω mesh pod pairs best with 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a standard MTL draw. The 1.2Ω option suits 20mg nic salts and 50/50 blends for a tighter, cigarette-style inhale. The 0.6Ω Lush Mesh works with 10mg nic salts or 50/50 freebase for restricted DTL vaping at higher wattage.
How long does a Vaporesso Eco Nano pod last?

A Vaporesso Eco Nano pod typically lasts 7 to 10 days for moderate vapers. Pod lifespan depends on refill frequency, e-liquid sweetness, and wattage setting. COREX Heating Tech extends coil life by up to 50 percent versus standard mesh coils in the same MTL pod category.

Vaporesso Eco Nano pods work with 50/50 PG/VG nic salts and 50/50 freebase e-liquids. Higher-VG blends thicken and slow wicking through the tight coil ports. UK vapers pair the pods with 10mg or 20mg nic salts sold in TRPR-compliant 10ml bottles for the best flavour and throat hit.

Yes, 50/50 freebase e-liquid works in the 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω pods. The 1.2Ω pod handles 50/50 e-liquid blends because of the tighter mesh aperture. Sub-ohm liquids at 70VG or above thicken and slow wicking through the coil, and Vape Connect recommends avoiding them in this pod range.

Pukka Juice Nic Salts have a balanced 50/50 VG/PG ratio, ideal for delivering both flavour and vapour.

Aspire Gotek Pro 2 gives you three selectable performance levels.
• Eco Mode reduces power consumption to extend battery life.
• Normal Mode balances battery efficiency with consistent vapour delivery.
• Max Mode increases power output for a stronger flavour and vapour response.
Smart Mode also automatically sets an appropriate wattage when a compatible pod is installed.
Aspire Gotek Pro 2 adjustable airflow slider lets you change how restricted the inhale feels. Closing the airflow creates a tighter MTL-style draw, while opening it produces a looser inhale.

Aspire Gotek Pro 2 is compatible with Aspire Gotek refillable pods in both 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω resistances. Each pod uses a built-in mesh coil, removing the need to change separate coil heads.

column1: How to Use Aspire Gotek Pro 2 Refillable Pod Kit?
Aspire Gotek Pro 2 uses a side-filling pod and inhale activation, making setup straightforward.
Remove the Gotek V2 pod from the device.
Open the side-fill port on the pod.
Fill the pod with a suitable 50% VG e-liquid and securely close the filling port.
Allow a new pod to sit after filling so the mesh coil can absorb the e-liquid before first use.
Insert the pod into the device until it fits securely.
Select Eco, Normal or Max Mode according to your preferred power level.
Adjust the airflow slider for a tighter or looser draw.
Inhale through the mouthpiece to activate the device automatically.
What E-Liquid Should You Use With Aspire Gotek Pro 2?
Aspire Gotek Pro 2 works best with 50% VG e-liquids. These balanced e-liquids suit the wicking requirements of the 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω Gotek mesh pods.
The 0.8Ω pod suits MTL vaping particularly well, while the 0.6Ω pod can provide a slightly airier RDTL draw when paired with an appropriate airflow setting.

OXVA Xlim Go Lite Pod Kit is a 41.5g auto-draw pod kit running Xlim pods from a 1000mAh battery at up to 30W. Draw on the mouthpiece and the coil fires on its own, with no buttons, no screen, and no settings anywhere on the device.

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit Overview"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-xlim-go-lite-pod-kit-overview.webp?v=1793283742"">

column1: A 0.8Ω Xlim top-fill (V3) pod arrives pre-installed, and the kit accepts the wider Xlim pod range from 0.4Ω to 1.2Ω, so the draw style is a pod swap away. An RGB light reports the battery, a side slider sets the airflow, and the whole kit weighs less than a 10ml bottle of e-liquid. Vape Connect stocks the Xlim Go Lite in 8 colours.
What is OXVA Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit?

OXVA Xlim Go Lite Refillable Pod Kit is an unmatched addition the Xlim family, built on the same 1000mAh, 5W to 30W platform as Xlim Go in a lighter PCTG and IML body. OXVA kept the auto-draw firing, the side airflow slider, and full Xlim pod compatibility, then swapped the leather wrap for a moulded shell to bring the price down. Each 2ml pod carries a sealed Unitech 2.0 mesh coil, and that 2ml pod capacity comes from UK TRPR rules, which allow users to vape freely.
OXVA Xlim Go Lite specifications confirm a 1000mAh battery, a 30W ceiling, and a 2ml pod capacity set by UK TRPR rules.

column3: >5W to 30W, set automatically by pod resistance
>Xlim V3 top-fill, EZ, and V2, 0.4Ω to 1.2Ω

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit Features"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-xlim-go-lite-pod-kit-features.webp?v=1793283211"">

column1: Xlim pods fit the Xlim Go Lite across the V3 top-fill, EZ, and V2 ranges, with the chipset supporting resistances from 0.3Ω to 3.0Ω.
Spare Oxva Xlim V3 Replacement Pods come in all four resistances as three-packs, each with a Unitech 2.0 mesh coil built in.

0.8Ω Xlim Top-Fill Pod
The 0.8Ω Xlim top-fill pod ships pre-installed and gives a standard mouth to lung draw. Nicotine salts at 10mg or 20mg in a 50/50 base pair with it cleanly. Most Lite owners never move off this resistance, because it balances flavour, battery life, and throat feel for everyday use.

0.4Ω and 0.6Ω Xlim Pods
The 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω Xlim pods open the Lite up towards restricted direct lung, with warmer vapour and denser clouds at the top of the 30W range. Both sell separately. The 0.4Ω pod draws the most power of the four, so expect the battery to need charging nightly on it.

1.2Ω Xlim Pod
The 1.2Ω Xlim pod gives the tightest pull the kit produces, closest to a cigarette of the four resistances. Adult smokers in their first weeks of switching land best here with a 20mg nicotine salt. Battery life stretches furthest on this pod, since it draws the least power per puff.
The RGB battery light on Oxva Xlim Go Lite Vape Device reports the charge level in three colours on each draw. The table below decodes them.
8 colours cover OXVA Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit across pastel, mist, and dark finishes.

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit Colours"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-xlim-go-lite-pod-kit-colours.webp?v=1793283211"">

column1: OXVA Xlim Go Lite vs Xlim Go vs Xlim Go 2
Followig are the main difference between these 3 xlim series vape kits by Oxva:

All three kits vape the same pods the same way, so the decision runs on battery, charging, and finish. Oxva Xlim Go Vape Kit adds the leather wrap and a wider colour range on identical internals. Oxva Xlim Go 2 Vape Kit steps the battery up to 1500mAh with 5V/2A fast charging, the pick for anyone who drains a kit before the day ends. The Lite wins on price and weight.
How to set up OXVA Xlim Go Lite Refillable Pod Kit?
To set up OXVA Xlim Go Lite, fill the pod from the top, prime the coil, and check the airflow before the first draw. The five steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
Pull the pod from the device and open the top-fill cap.
Fill the 2ml pod with e-liquid matched to the pod resistance.
Close the cap and seat the pod firmly back in the device.
Leave the pod standing for five minutes so the mesh coil wicks fully.
Set the airflow slider to the middle, then draw on the mouthpiece.
Skipping the five minute prime burns the cotton and ruins the pod, which is the single most common cause of a burnt taste on a new kit.
Every OXVA Xlim Go Lite kit arrives ready to fill, with the 0.8Ω pod already seated in the device.
• 1 x OXVA Xlim Go Lite device
No USB-C cable comes in the box. Any USB-C lead on a standard charger covers the 5V/1A input.
OXVA Xlim Go Lite Vape Kit FAQs
Is OXVA Xlim Go Lite suitable for beginners?

Yes, OXVA Xlim Go Lite is suitable for beginners, because the kit has no buttons, no settings, and no menus. Auto-draw fires the coil on inhale, and the device sets the wattage from the fitted pod on its own. Filling the pod and priming the coil are the only skills the kit asks for.
Which pods fit OXVA Xlim Go Lite Vape?

Xlim pods fit OXVA Xlim Go Lite across the V3 top-fill, EZ, and V2 ranges, in 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, and 1.2Ω resistances. Each pod carries a built-in Unitech 2.0 mesh coil. Nexlim and Oneo pods do not fit this device, since they belong to different OXVA platforms.
What is the anxiety-relief dot on OXVA Xlim Go Lite Kit?

The anxiety-relief dot on OXVA Xlim Go Lite is a small raised circle moulded into the body where a thumb naturally rests, designed for idle fidgeting between draws. The dot is a tactile design feature and nothing more. No other kit in the Xlim range carries one.
How long does the OXVA Xlim Go Lite battery last?

The 1000mAh battery in the OXVA Xlim Go Lite lasts a full day of regular vaping on the 0.8Ω pod. OXVA quote up to two days from a single charge on moderate mouth to lung use, a manufacturer figure based on lighter sessions. Lower-resistance pods at higher wattage drain the cell faster.
How do you fill an OXVA Xlim Go Lite pod?

To fill an OXVA Xlim Go Lite pod, open the cap on top of the pod, add e-liquid slowly until it sits just below the fill line, and close the cap. The top-fill design means the pod stays seated in the device. Leave a new pod standing five minutes before the first draw.
Why does my OXVA Xlim Go Lite taste burnt?

A burnt taste on the OXVA Xlim Go Lite comes from a dry coil, usually caused by vaping a fresh pod before the cotton soaks. Leave a filled pod standing five minutes before the first draw. Running a thick 70/30 shortfill through the 0.8Ω or 1.2Ω pod produces the same dry result.
Is OXVA Xlim Go Lite Refillable Vape Kit MTL or DTL?

OXVA Xlim Go Lite is an MTL kit first, with a restricted direct lung option rather than full DTL. The boxed 0.8Ω pod and the 1.2Ω pod give a mouth to lung draw, and a 0.4Ω or 0.6Ω pod with the airflow slider open loosens the pull into RDL territory.
What e-liquid can you use in OXVA Xlim Go Lite?

OXVA Xlim Go Lite takes nicotine salts, 50/50 e-liquids, and 70/30 shortfills, with the pod deciding which suits better. A 50/50 nic salt at 10mg or 20mg matches the 0.8Ω and 1.2Ω pods. Thicker 70/30 shortfills wick well through the 0.4Ω pod near 30W. UK TRPR rules cap nicotine e-liquid at 20mg/ml.

Pyne Pod Nic Salts

Pyne Pod Nic Salts are a range of 10ml e-liquids formulated with 20mg, 10mg and 5mg nicotine strength options with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio. Designed for compatible mouth-to-lung (MTL) refillable pod kits, this nic salt contains 20 flavours spanning fruit, candy, mint and ice profiles.

Pyne Pod Nic Salts include flavours also found in the Pyne Pod Click refill pod range, alongside bottled options such as Strawberry Cherry, Blackberry Blackcurrant and Pomegranate Ice. Each bottle comes with a child-resistant cap, and the e-liquid can be used with suitable refillable devices across different brands.

Pyne Pod Nic Salts come in 10ml bottles with a 50% VG / 50% PG blend and 20mg/ml, 10mg/ml and 5mg/ml nicotine strengths. The table below outlines their formulation, bottle details and intended device type.
Compatible refillable MTL pod kits suitable for 50/50 nicotine salt e-liquids
Pyne Pod Nic Salts come in 20 flavours, covering berry blends, tropical fruit, citrus, candy and mint. The table below lists each flavour and its main flavour notes.
Pyne Pod Nic Salt E-liquids Device Compatibility

Pyne Pod Nic Salts have a 50% VG / 50% PG blend intended for compatible refillable mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits. Compatibility depends on the fitted pod or coil and the device manufacturer’s e-liquid guidance.

Pyne Pod Nic Salts are not restricted to Pyne Pod devices. They can be used in other brands refillable kits where the manufacturer supports 50/50 nicotine salt e-liquids. Follow the recommended power range for the installed coil.

Pyne Pod Nic Salts should only be added to cartridges or tanks designed for refilling. Sealed prefilled pods, including Pyne Pod Click refill cartridges, should not be opened and topped up with bottled e-liquid.
How to Use Pyne Pod Nicotine Salt E-liquids?
Pyne Pod Nic Salts are ready-mixed e-liquids for compatible refillable pod kits. Use them as supplied, without adding nicotine shots or diluting the liquid.
Check compatibility: Confirm that your pod or coil supports 50/50 nicotine salt e-liquid.
Open the filling port: Follow your device’s instructions to access the pod’s filling port.
Fill the pod: Add the liquid through the designated opening, keeping it out of the central airflow tube. Do not exceed the pod’s maximum fill level.
Close securely: Replace the stopper or mouthpiece and wipe away any spilled liquid.
Allow a new coil to saturate: Follow the manufacturer’s recommended priming time before using a newly filled pod or coil.
Follow the coil’s power range: If your device has adjustable wattage, stay within the range specified for the fitted coil.
Keep the bottle tightly closed after filling and stored out of reach of children and pets.
Pyne Pod Nic Salts are supplied as:
• 1 × 10ml bottle of Pyne Pod Nic Salt E-Liquid in your selected flavour and nicotine strength.

The vape device, refillable pod and replacement coils are not included.

What is Elux Legend 8000 Prefilled Pod Kit?

Elux Legend 8000 Prefilled Pod Kit is a rechargeable prefilled pod device that replaces discontinued Elux Legend disposable range. column1: How to set up Elux Legend 8000 Pod Vape Kit?

To set up Elux Legend 8000 Kit, join the pod to the refill container, seat the assembly in the device, and wait for the coil to wick. The six steps below cover the process from unboxing to the first draw.
Charge the device over USB-C until the LED indicator shows a full battery.
Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging.
Push the container into the base of the pod until the two lock together.
Slide the assembled pack into the top of the Elux Legend 8000 body.
Rest the device upright for three to five minutes so the mesh coil wicks fully.
Draw on the mouthpiece to fire the coil, since the device activates on inhale.
Who the Elux Legend 8000 Vape Pod Kit Suits?
Elux Legend 8000 pod vape kit suits 4 groups of adult vapers, ranked by how closely the device matches their needs.
Former disposable users, who want the Elux Legend flavours they already know in a legal, rechargeable format after the June 2025 ban.
Adult smokers switching from cigarettes, who need a cigarette-style draw and quick craving relief from 20mg nicotine salt.
Vapers wanting low maintenance, who prefer sealed packs over filling bottles and fitting coils.
Vapers tracking cost, who get 12ml per pack rather than the 2ml a standard prefilled pod delivers.
Is Elux Legend 8000 Kit legal in the UK?

Yes, Elux Legend 8000 pod vape kit is legal in the UK, because the 2ml pod and 10ml refill container both sit within TRPR limits. Nicotine tops out at 20mg/ml, the UK maximum. The kit is a rechargeable pod device rather than a single-use vape, so the June 2025 disposable ban does not apply.
How does Elux Legend 8000 deliver 8,000 puffs from a 2ml pod?

Elux Legend 8000 delivers 8,000 puffs by feeding the 2ml pod from a sealed 10ml refill container, giving 12ml per pack. The pod never holds more than 2ml at once, meeting one TRPR limit, and the container never exceeds 10ml, meeting the other. Spread across 12ml, 8,000 puffs works out at roughly 1.5 microlitres per puff.
How long does an Elux Legend 8000 pod pack last?

An Elux Legend 8000 pod pack lasts close to 20 days for a moderate mouth-to-lung vaper, based on 12ml of e-liquid and 400 puffs a day. Heavier use shortens that to roughly ten days. Draw length, draw frequency, and how warm the coil runs each move the real figure.

No, the Elux Legend 8000 pod is not refillable, because the pod arrives sealed with an integrated mesh coil fitted. Replace the full pack once flavour thins or vapour output drops. The device itself recharges and is reused indefinitely, so only the pod pack is swapped out.
What battery does Elux Legend 8000 Pod Kit use?

Elux Legend 8000 pod vape kit uses a 1000mAh built-in rechargeable battery, charged over USB-C from a port on the device body. An LED indicator reports charge state. The cell carries a typical mouth-to-lung vaper through a full day, and one pod pack outlasts several charge cycles.

Elux Legend 8000 comes in one nicotine strength, 20mg/ml (2%) nicotine salt. UK TRPR rules cap nicotine e-liquid at 20mg/ml, so 20mg is the strongest option legally sold in Britain. Nicotine salt absorbs faster than freebase nicotine, which settles cravings quickly without a harsh throat sensation.
What flavours does Elux Legend 8000 come in?

Elux Legend 8000 comes in 16 flavours at Vape Connect, split across fruit, ice, and sweet profiles. Fruit options include Triple Mango, Grape, and Blueberry Raspberry. Ice options include Watermelon Ice, Red Apple Ice, and Fresh Mint. Sweet and drink options cover Blue Razz Gummy, Fizzy Cherry, and Oasis.
Are Elux Legend 8000 pods compatible with other Elux devices?

No, Elux Legend 8000 pods are compatible with the Elux Legend 8000 kit only. The sealed pod and refill container seat into the Legend 8000 battery housing, so other Elux devices take a different pod format. Check the kit name printed on your device before ordering a replacement pack.
Why is my Elux Legend 8000 producing weak vapour?

Weak vapour from an Elux Legend 8000 points to a low battery, a partly seated pod pack, or a coil that has reached the end of the pack. Charge the device first, then reseat the pack until the container clicks into the pod. Replace the pack if flavour stays thin after both checks.

FAQs About OXVA Oneo Replacement Pods
Do OXVA Oneo pods fit Oneo Pro?

column1: Are OXVA Oneo pods TRPR compliant?

Can you use nic salts in OXVA Oneo pods?

Yes, OXVA Oneo pods accept nic salt and freebase e-liquid. Nic salts at 10mg/ml or 20mg/ml suit higher resistances such as 0.8Ω and 1.2Ω, delivering a smoother mouth-to-lung draw. Freebase e-liquid suits 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω at raised wattage.
Can you refill an OXVA Oneo pod?
Yes, OXVA Oneo pods refill from the top. Lift the cap, fill to the 2ml line, and refit the cap. Refilling before the e-liquid drops below the coil intake protects the cotton from scorching.
Why does my OXVA Oneo pod taste burnt?

A burnt taste means the coil has fired without enough e-liquid reaching the cotton. Dry firing, skipped priming, high wattage on a high-resistance coil, and chain vaping each cause the same damage. Replace the pod, because a burnt coil cannot be restored.
How many times can you refill an OXVA Oneo pod?

OXVA Oneo pods refill until flavour drops off, typically across 1 to 2 weeks of regular use. Sweetened e-liquids and higher wattage shorten that window. Replace the pod at the first burnt or muted draw rather than pushing the coil further.
Which OXVA Oneo pod resistance is best for beginners?

0.8Ω suits most beginners, because the resistance delivers a familiar mouth-to-lung draw with nic salt at 10mg/ml or 20mg/ml. Adult smokers wanting a tighter, more cigarette-like inhale should choose 1.2Ω instead.

Geekvape Aegis Force Mod Kit covers both draw styles from one device, boxing an MTL drip tip and a DTL drip tip alongside two B Series coils. A 3200mAh battery drives up to 80W through the AS chipset, a 0.96 inch colour screen reads wattage, battery and puff count, and Smart Mode sets a safe power level the moment a coil is fitted. Coils swap out of the cartridge individually, and the B Series range runs from 0.15Ω sub-ohm to 1.2Ω mouth to lung.
What is Geekvape Aegis Force Pod Mod Kit?

Geekvape Aegis Force kit is a pod-mod, a device pairing pod-kit handling with the power and replaceable coils of a compact mod. The AS chipset drives B Series coils from 5W to 80W, drawing up to 30A from the built-in cell, and a 0.96 inch colour screen carries the settings. Coils press into the Aegis Force cartridge and pull out individually, so a spent coil costs a coil rather than a whole cartridge. The cartridge holds 2ml, the UK TRPR maximum for any tank or pod sold in Britain.

column1: B Series coils are the replaceable for Aegis Force, and 7 resistances run in the kit across the range.

B 0.2Ω and B 0.4Ω coils in the box
The B 0.2Ω Boost coil arrives pre-installed and runs between 50W and 58W for a warm direct lung vape on shortfill e-liquid. The B 0.4Ω spare sits at 25W to 35W for a restricted direct draw, cooler and easier on both battery and bottle. Between them the boxed pair covers the sub-ohm half of the kit's range without another purchase.

B Series MTL coils for a tighter draw
The B 0.8Ω and B 1.2Ω MTL coils take the Aegis Force down to a genuine mouth to lung draw with nicotine salts, the tightest pulls the platform makes. Both sell separately, and pairing one with the boxed MTL drip tip is what turns this kit into a switching smoker's device.
6 finishes cover the Geekvape Aegis Force, from plain neutrals to a shifting patterned option.

column1: How to set up Geekvape Aegis Force?
To set up Geekvape Aegis Force, fit a coil, fill the cartridge, and let it soak before firing. The 6 steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
Pull the cartridge from the device and check the coil in its base, the B 0.2Ω is fitted from the factory.
Lift the silicone plug beside the coil and fill the 2ml cartridge with a suitable e-liquid.
Press the plug shut and leave the cartridge standing for five minutes.
Fit the DTL drip tip for the boxed coils, or the MTL tip if an MTL coil is fitted.
Seat the cartridge, unlock the fire button, and leave the kit in Smart Mode for the first session.
Adjust the top airflow ring while drawing, and switch to Power Mode later to fine-tune the wattage.

Stand the filled tank upright for five minutes so the cotton soaks fully.
Screw the tank back on, hold the device so Smart Unlock wakes it, and press the fire button five times to switch on.

Draw while adjusting the top airflow, then raise the wattage a few watts at a time to taste.

column1: How to Use OXVA VPrime 2 Pod Vape Kit?
To set up OXVA VPrime 2, fill the pod, prime the coil, and set your wattage before the first draw. The five steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
• Pull the pod from the device and lift the fill plug on the side.
• Fill the 2ml pod with e-liquid matched to the pod resistance.
• Press the plug back down and seat the pod firmly in the device.
• Leave the pod standing for five minutes so the dual mesh coil wicks fully.
• Set the wattage on the screen to the range for that pod, then draw on the mouthpiece.
Skipping the five minute prime burns the cotton and ruins the pod, which is the single most common cause of a burnt taste on a new kit.

FAQs About Vaporesso Xros Mini Retro Vape Kit
What is Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro Pod Kit?

Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro Pod Kit is a compact, refillable pod device with a 1000mAh battery and 18W max output. The XROS Mini Retro uses auto-draw activation and a 0.6Ω COREX 3.0 pod for MTL vaping with nicotine salts and 50/50 e-liquid.
Does Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro come with a charging cable?

What pods are compatible with Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro?
Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro accepts the full XROS pod range, including 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, and 1.2Ω COREX pods. Higher-resistance pods tighten the draw for a firmer MTL pull at the device's 18W max.

Is Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro pod refillable?

Does Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro have adjustable airflow?
No, Vaporesso XROS Mini Retro has fixed airflow with no slider to adjust. Draw tightness changes by pod resistance, with higher-resistance XROS pods giving a firmer MTL pull.

OXVA Nexlim Go Vape Kit is a screenless refillable pod kit built around a 1800mAh battery and UNITECH 2.0 dual mesh Nexlim pods. Draw on the mouthpiece and the coil fires within 0.01 seconds, with no button, no screen, and no menu anywhere on the device. A slide switch moves the kit between Boost and Eco modes, and the fitted pod sets the wattage on its own across the 5W to 40W range. One 0.8Ω Nexlim pod arrives pre-installed, with 0.6Ω and 1.2Ω pods available separately for a looser or tighter draw. Vape Connect stocks the Nexlim Go in 8 colours.

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Nexlim Go Vape Kit Overview"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-nexlim-go-pod-kit-overview.webp?v=1793284778"">

column1: What is the OXVA Nexlim Go Pod Kit?

OXVA Nexlim Go Pod Vape Kit is the screenless version of OXVA Nexlim, running the same Nexlim pods and the same 5W to 40W output from a simpler body. OXVA removed the colour screen, the fire button, and the wattage menu, then grew the battery from 1500mAh to 1800mAh in the process.

Power management moves to a physical slide switch and an LED, so the kit operates entirely by feel. Each 2ml pod carries a sealed dual mesh coil, and a tired coil means a fresh pod rather than a coil change. That 2ml ceiling comes from UK TRPR rules, which allows the vapers to enjoy an unmatched vaping experience without any hassle.
OXVA Nexlim Go specifications confirm a 1800mAh battery, a 40W ceiling, and a 2ml pod capacity set by UK TRPR rules.

column3: >5W to 40W, set automatically by pod and mode
>Nicotine salts, 50/50, and 70/30 shortfills on the 0.6Ω pod

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Nexlim Go Vape Kit Features"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-nexlim-go-pod-kit-features.webp?v=1793284778"">

column1: 3 Nexlim pod resistances run in Oxva Nexlim Go Refillable Pod Kit, and the mode switch sets a fixed wattage for each one. The table below matches every pod to its draw style, its Boost and Eco wattages, and the e-liquid that suits it.

0.6Ω Nexlim Pod
The 0.6Ω Nexlim pod is the restricted direct lung option, reaching the full 40W in Boost mode. Vapour runs warmer and denser than on either MTL pod, and the airflow slider opened fully gives the loosest draw the kit produces. This pod sells separately, since only the 0.8Ω comes boxed.

0.8Ω Nexlim Pod
The 0.8Ω Nexlim pod arrives pre-installed and sits in mouth to lung vaping style, running 30W in Boost and 16W in Eco. Nicotine salts at 10mg or 20mg in a 50/50 base pair with it cleanly. Most buyers stay on this resistance, because it balances flavour, battery life, and throat hit.

1.2Ω Nexlim Pod
The 1.2Ω Nexlim pod gives the tightest draw of the three, at 22W in Boost and 13W in Eco. The pull sits closest to a cigarette, which suits adult smokers in their first weeks of switching. Battery life stretches furthest on this pod, since the wattage runs lowest across both modes.

Oxva Nexlim Go Kit comes with UNITECH 2.0 dual mesh coil platform inside every Nexlim pod. 2 mesh strips fire together across the coil, spreading heat wider than a single strip and keeping the separate notes in a fruit or dessert e-liquid distinct instead of blurred.

OXVA quote up to 200% more flavour and 200% longer coil life against single mesh, with a stated lifespan of up to 120ml of e-liquid, around 30 refills of a 2ml pod. The coil is sealed into the pod, so flavour resets with a new pod rather than fading through a coil swap. Spare Oxva Nexlim Pods come in all three resistances as three-packs.
LED battery indicator on Oxva Nexlim Go Vape Kit replaces the screen, reporting the charge level in three colours during each draw. The table below decodes them.
8 colours cover OXVA Nexlim Go, 3 in the soft-touch silky finish and 5 across solid and textured panels.

column3: >Space Grey, Starry Blue, Rose Pink, Sahara Brown, Black Warrior

column17: loading=""lazy"" alt=""Oxva Nexlim Go Vape Kit Colours"" src=""https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0503/4292/0376/files/oxva-nexlim-go-pod-kit-colours.webp?v=1793284778"">

column1: Following are the reasons why Oxva Nexlim Go stand outs in the Nexlim range:

Oxva Nexlim keeps the colour screen, the fire button, and the second boxed pod for vapers who want full readouts. The Go trades all three for 300mAh more battery and a simpler pocket carry at a lower price.
How to set up OXVA Nexlim Go Refillable Pod Kit?
To set up OXVA Nexlim Go, fill the pod from the top, prime the coil, and pick a mode before the first draw. The five steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
Pull the pod from the device and open the top-fill cap.
Fill the 2ml pod with e-liquid matched to the pod resistance.
Close the cap and seat the pod firmly back in the device.
Leave the pod standing for 5minutes so the dual mesh coil wicks fully.
Slide the switch to Eco for a first session, then draw on the mouthpiece.
Every OXVA Nexlim Go kit arrives ready to fill, with the 0.8Ω pod already seated in the device.
No USB-C cable comes in the box. Any USB-C lead on a 5V/2A charger handles the 45 minute charge.
Is OXVA Nexlim Go suitable for beginners?

Yes, OXVA Nexlim Go is suitable for beginners, because every control decision is made by the hardware. Auto-draw fires the coil on inhale with no button, and the device sets the wattage from the fitted pod and the slide switch position. Filling, priming, and drawing are the only skills the kit asks for.
Which pods fit OXVA Nexlim Go Vape Device?

Nexlim pods fit the OXVA Nexlim Go in all three resistances, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, and 1.2Ω, each carrying a UNITECH 2.0 dual mesh coil. The same pods fit the original OXVA Nexlim, so the two kits share spares. Xlim, Oneo, and Nexlim V2 pods do not fit this device.
How long does OXVA Nexlim Go battery last?

The 1800mAh battery in the OXVA Nexlim Go lasts a full day of regular vaping in Boost mode, and considerably longer in Eco. OXVA quote up to 10 days in Eco mode on the lightest pairing, a manufacturer figure based on low-wattage use. Higher wattage on the 0.6Ω pod drains the cell fastest.

Pod Salt Nexliq takes the brand's established nic salt base and layers it with sharper, more modern flavour profiles for vapers who want something bolder than a standard fruit salt:
Next-generation Pod Salt range: Nexliq sits above the core Pod Salt line as the brand's bolder, flavour-forward release.
Nic salt base: A smoother throat hit than freebase nicotine at the same strength, with faster nicotine absorption.
50/50 VG/PG ratio: Tuned for MTL pod kits so flavour comes through sharply rather than getting lost in heavy vapour.
Three strength options: 5mg suits light vapers stepping down, 10mg suits moderate daily use, and 20mg suits heavy smokers switching to vaping or long-time nic salt users.
Bold modern flavour profiles: Aqua water notes, gummy candy twists and frozen tropical blends set Nexliq apart from standard fruit salts.
10ml TPD bottle: Child-resistant cap and tamper-evident seal across every bottle in the range.
Wide pod kit compatibility: Works with any MTL pod kit, including refillable kits and prefilled pods designed to accept a 50/50 nic salt.
Pod Salt Nexliq launches with 10 bold flavours spanning citrus, berry, tropical, candy and ice. The full flavour breakdown sits in the table below:
Crisp, tart lemon paired with a clean, refreshing water note for a light, zesty vape.
Ripe strawberry sweetness lifted by a smooth, cooling aqua finish.
Tangy blue raspberry with a chewy gummy bear sweetness on the exhale.

Sweet cherry and sharp lemon layered over a fizzy, sparkling finish.
