Sweet mixed berries carried by a subtle citrus twist for a bold, moreish pour.
Sweet, tart raspberry refreshed by a cool mint breeze on the exhale.
Bold sour grape finished with a frosty ice chill for a sharp, cooling vape.
Fruit, tropical and ice profiles lead the Nexliq lineup, with a candy and a soda option for anyone after a sweeter or sharper change of pace.
Who Should Use Pod Salt Nexliq Nic Salt Vape Liquid?
Pod Salt Nexliq Nicotine Salts suit a wide range of adult vapers looking for a bolder nic salt on a MTL setup:
MTL pod kit users: A 50/50 base is a direct match for refillable pod kits, prefilled bars with refillable pods and low-wattage MTL devices.
Smokers switching to vaping: 20mg nic salt delivers a cigarette-strength hit with a smoother throat feel than freebase at the same strength.
Established vapers scaling back: 10mg suits anyone stepping down from 20mg, while 5mg is a gentle option for vapers winding nicotine down further.
Flavour hoppers: Ten bold Nexliq flavours cover citrus, berry, tropical, candy and ice without repeating the same profile twice.
Vapers moving on from disposables: Nexliq delivers disposable-style bold flavour in a refillable 10ml format that is cheaper per ml and easier to recycle.
How to Use Pod Salt Nexliq Nicotine Salts
Pod Salt Nexliq is ready to vape straight from the bottle. Fill a compatible MTL pod or tank, let the coil prime for a few minutes, then install it in your kit and inhale.
Choose your strength: Pick 5mg for a very light hit, 10mg for a moderate daily pour or 20mg for a cigarette-strength nic salt experience.
Open the bottle: Press down and twist the child-resistant cap to open the 10ml dropper bottle.
Fill the pod or tank: Add Nexliq to the fill port of a compatible MTL pod or refillable tank, taking care not to overfill.
Let the coil prime: Wait 5 to 10 minutes so the coil wick fully absorbs the e-liquid before the first draw.
Install the pod or tank: Fit the pod or tank into your MTL kit and check the connection is secure.
Inhale MTL style: Draw slowly on the mouthpiece using a mouth-to-lung inhale for the best flavour and throat hit.
Store between sessions: Keep the bottle upright in a cool, dark place and out of reach of children and pets.

column1: Why Choose Higo BB 4000 Prefilled Vape Kit

Higo BB 4000 Kit is an ideal fusion of smoothness and reliability which comes with a huge list of features, elevating your vaping experience by up to 4 times and making it the best alternative after the UK disposable vape ban. From its strong battery to the simple pod swap system, it has all that you need at an cost-effective price, making it an ideal choice for both beginners and seasoned vapers.
Following are the main reasons to choose Higo BB 4k Prefilled Pod Kit:

Higo BB 4000 Pod Kit comes with an easy swap system which lets you change pods fast with a clean, click-fit design, no tools, no mess. The 2ml pod locks to the 4ml refill container, and when it is empty you simply detach and slot in a fresh pack. Switch flavours in seconds while maintaining flavour integrity and minimising leaks. Built for on-the-go use, it cuts downtime, just carry a couple of spares and keep vaping. Fully compatible with official Higo BB Refill Packs.

Higo BB 4000 is available in a variety of exciting flavours covers cool mints, bold berries, citrus zests, and sweet candy profiles, so it is easy to lock in a favourite or switch it up. Each option is blended for clean, consistent taste and smooth nic-salt delivery, with cooling levels balanced rather than overpowering. Rotate flavours in seconds with the Easy Swap System to keep your palate fresh without cross-mixing. Whether you lean menthol, fruit, or soda-inspired, there is a satisfying all-day flavour here for every mood.
How to Use Crystal Higo BB 4000 Vape Kit
Following are the easy steps to start your vaping journey with Higo Crystal BB 4000 Puffs Vape:
Click-fit the pod: Attach the 4ml refill container to the 2ml pod until it clicks securely.
Insert into device: Slide the assembled pod into your device until it sits flush.
Inhale to vape: Draw on the mouthpiece to activate, no buttons, no menus. Delivers a smooth MTL (cigarette-like) pull with discreet vapour.
Monitor battery: The LED screen shows battery life so you always know your remaining charge.
Recharge when low: When the LED indicates low power, recharge the device.
Swap when empty: Detach the empty refill container and click in a fresh pack to keep vaping or switch flavours in seconds.
FAQs About Higo BB 4000 Puff Pod Vape Kit

Higo BB 4000 is a compact MTL vape kit built for simplicity, consistency, and clean flavour. It suits adult smokers transitioning to vaping and experienced users who want a fuss-free, reliable daily device.
Does Higo BB 4000 Vape Kit have adjustable airflow?
No, Higo BB 4000 uses fixed airflow and preset power, tuned for smooth, cigarette-like MTL draws. This eliminates setup complexity and keeps performance consistent across flavours and refill packs.
Is Crystal Higo BB 4000 Pod Vape Kit refillable?

User refilling is not required. Higo BB 4000 uses the Easy Swap System, when the pod is empty, detach it and click in an official Higo BB Refill Pack to continue vaping with minimal downtime and mess.
What nicotine strength does Higo BB 4000 Kit use?
Higo BB 4000 is designed for 20mg nic salt for a smooth throat hit and quick satisfaction. Nic salts help deliver consistent flavour and vapour at lower temperatures suitable for MTL vaping.
How long does Higo BB 4000 Prefilled Kit battery last?
With its 900mAh battery, Higo BB 4000 typically covers a full day for most MTL users. Actual battery life varies by draw length and frequency, but the tuning prioritises stable output and efficiency.
Which pods are compatible with Higo BB 4000?

Higo BB 4000 is compatible with official Higo BB 4000 Pods. Using genuine pods ensures proper fit, stable performance, and the intended flavour delivery from the mesh-coil design.

column1: What is Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Vape Kit?

Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Pod Kit is a refillable pod device that replaces the 4 Nano's buttons-and-screen interface with a genuine touchscreen. Firing stays on the inhale, so the screen never gets between a vaper and a draw, and the chipset matches output to whichever XROS pod clicks into the magnetic seat. column1: COREX 3.0 dual mesh pods are the current generation Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano ships with, and the full XROS pod series fits its seat.

Dual mesh Pods
The 0.6Ω COREX 3.0 pod arrives pre-installed for a full, warm restricted draw, and the 0.8Ω spare balances vapour against battery for all-day use. Dual mesh heats the coil surface evenly, which is where the generation's flavour gains come from. Between them the boxed pair covers most vapers without another purchase.

0.4Ω Pod
The 0.4Ω COREX 3.0 pod switches the screen from presets to manual wattage up to 30W, selling separately in the UK. Legacy 1.0Ω and 1.2Ω XROS pods fit the same seat for vapers who want the tightest cigarette-like pulls the platform makes.
8 colours cover the Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano, split across three surface treatments.

column1: Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano vs XROS 4 Nano vs XROS 3 Nano
Three generations now ladder the top of the XROS family, and the table below shows what each adds.
How to set up Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Vape Kit?
To set up Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano, fill a pod, let the coil soak, and pick a mode on the touchscreen. The 5 steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
Pull the pod from the magnetic seat and open its top fill cap.
Fill the 2ml pod with a nicotine salt or 50/50 e-liquid, then close the cap.
Seat the pod back on the device and leave it standing for five minutes.
Press the home button to wake the screen, then swipe to Eco mode with the airflow towards closed.
Draw on the mouthpiece, then open the airflow and step up the mode as the pod beds in.
Every Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano kit arrives with two pods, its charging lead, and a lanyard.
• 1 x User manual, reminder card, and warranty card

Vaporesso Armour G Pod Vape Kit FAQs
Is Vaporesso Armour G suitable for beginners?

Yes, Vaporesso Armour G suits beginners who want room to grow more than absolute first-day simplicity. The chip reads the fitted coil and suggests a safe wattage, which removes the main sub-ohm mistake. Complete newcomers wanting nothing to learn land easier on a sealed auto-draw pod kit first, then step up to this.
Which coils fit Vaporesso Armour G Vape Device?

GTX coils fit the Vaporesso Armour G across the full platform, from 0.15Ω to 1.2Ω, covering DTL, RDL, and MTL draws. Each coil carries its rated wattage window printed on the side. GTi coils from the Armour S and XROS pods do not fit, since they belong to different Vaporesso platforms.
Is Vaporesso Armour G MTL or DTL?

Vaporesso Armour G is a DTL kit out of the box and an MTL kit with the right coil. The boxed 0.2Ω and 0.4Ω coils cover direct and restricted lung draws. Fit a 0.8Ω or 1.2Ω GTX coil, close the airflow, and the draw tightens to mouth to lung.
What is the difference between Armour G and Armour GS?

Vaporesso Armour G carries a built-in 3000mAh battery, and the Armour GS runs a removable 18650 cell sold separately. Both fire the same 5W to 80W output through the same pods and GTX coils. Pick the G for charge-and-go simplicity, and the GS for swappable batteries on long days.
What is NEO Pulse mode on Vaporesso Armour G?

NEO Pulse mode on the Vaporesso Armour G fires the coil in rapid pulses that compensate for falling battery voltage. A standard kit softens as the battery drains, and pulse firing counters that, with Vaporesso quoting consistent output from full charge to low. Switching between pulse and standard output takes a moment on the screen.
Why does my Vaporesso Armour G Pod Kit taste burnt?

A burnt taste on Vaporesso Armour G comes from a dry coil, caused by vaping a fresh coil before the cotton soaks or by firing above the coil's rated window. Prime every new coil and leave the filled pod five minutes. Check the screen sits inside the wattage printed on the coil.
What e-liquid can you use in Vaporesso Armour G Kit?

Vaporesso Armour G takes 70/30 shortfills on its sub-ohm coils and 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquids on its MTL coils. Run 3mg or 6mg through the 0.2Ω and 0.3Ω coils, since high wattage amplifies nicotine harshness. UK TRPR rules cap nicotine e-liquid at 20mg/ml in 10ml bottles.
How do you lock Vaporesso Armour G?

Vaporesso Armour G locks through its fire button, a one-button lock and unlock that freezes firing and settings for pocket carry. The screen confirms the locked state when you press the button. Locking before the kit goes into a bag stops accidental firing against keys and coins.

column1: How to set up Vaporesso XROS 4 Nano Vape Pod Kit?
To set up Vaporesso XROS 4 Nano Refillable Pod Kit, fill the pod, let the coil soak, and pick a mode on the screen. The five steps below run from unboxing to vaping.
Pull the pod from the magnetic seat and open its top fill port.
Fill the 2ml pod with a nicotine salt or 50/50 e-liquid, then close the port.
Seat the pod back on the device and leave it standing for five minutes.
Press the button 5 times for settings, then pick Eco mode and a closed airflow for a first session.
Draw on the mouthpiece or press the button, then open the airflow and step up the mode as the pod beds in.
Every Vaporesso XROS 4 Nano kit arrives with two pods, its charging lead, and a lanyard.

Vaporesso Luxe XR Max Pod Vape Kit

Vaporesso Luxe XR Max Vape Kit is a high-performance pod kit designed for vapers who demand power, versatility, and cutting-edge technology. Engineered with an ultra-high-density 2800mAh battery, this compact yet powerful device delivers up to 80W max output, ensuring all-day vaping without compromise. Powered by Vaporesso’s advanced AXON chip, it offers smart touch button controls, intelligent coil recognition, and customized airflow adjustment, making it an ideal choice for both beginners and experienced vapers.

This vape kit is compatible with the GTX coil platform, allowing users to switch between MTL (Mouth-to-Lung), RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung), and DTL (Direct-to-Lung) vaping styles with ease. The innovative COREX heating technology ensures even heating for richer flavor and dense vapor production, while the SSS leak-resistant design prevents spills and leaks for a mess-free experience. Its sleek, futuristic design features a crystal-clear body with an energetic breathing light, giving it a stylish and modern look.

Whether you prefer a smooth MTL vape, a balanced RDL draw, or a powerful DTL cloud-chasing experience, the Vaporesso Luxe XR Max Pod Vape Kit adapts to your needs effortlessly. Elevate your vaping experience with this compact yet powerful vape, designed for those who seek performance, reliability, and style in one exceptional device.

Powerful 2800mAh Battery: Ensures long-lasting vaping sessions.
Fast USB-C Charging: Quick recharge for minimal downtime.
Smart Adjustable Wattage: Automatically detects and adjusts power for optimal performance.
Up to 80W Output: Customizable wattage for different vaping styles.
AXON Chipset Technology: Provides rapid firing, stable power, and multiple safety protections.
Adjustable Airflow System: Rotate the pod to fine-tune your vaping experience.
Compatible with All GTX Coils: Supports DTL, RDL, and MTL vaping styles.
Supports Luxe X Built-in Coil Pods: Pre-installed coil pods for easy maintenance.
Leak-Resistant Pod Design: SSS leak-resistant technology prevents messes and e-liquid wastage.
Transparent Pods: Easily check e-liquid levels to avoid dry hits.
Durable and Lightweight Design: Portable and ergonomic for on-the-go vaping.
Simple Button Activation: Hassle-free operation with easy controls

RDL Pod (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) - Balanced Experience
The RDL pod offers a slightly more restrictive inhale, delivering a balance between flavour intensity and vapour production. It supports the following GTX RDL coils:
GTX 0.4Ω Mesh (Included with kit) - 26-32W (Best at 30W)
GTX 0.6Ω Mesh - 20-30W (Best at 24W)

GTX 0.6Ω Mesh - 20-30W (Best at 28W)

GTX 1.2Ω Regular - 8-12W (Best at 11W)
Compatible with Luxe X Built-in Coil Pods
If you prefer built-in coil pods instead of replaceable coils, the Vaporesso Luxe XR Max is also compatible with Luxe X pods. Available resistances include:
0.4Ω Mesh DTL Pod - 32W
0.6Ω Mesh RDL Pod
0.8Ω Mesh MTL Pod - 16W
SSS Leak-Resistant Technology - Mess-Free Vaping
Vaporesso has integrated SSS leak-resistant technology into the Luxe XR pods, effectively locking in e-liquid and reducing the chances of leaks, making it a hassle-free vaping option.

column1: GTX Replacement Coils cover a 7W to 75W range, matching low-power MTL vaping through to high-output DTL cloud production. Lower resistances from 0.15Ω to 0.3Ω use Nickel-Chromium heating elements for direct-to-lung draws, and higher resistances from 0.8Ω to 1.2Ω use Kanthal for a tighter mouth-to-lung draw with nic salt e-liquids. Vape Connect stocks genuine Vaporesso GTX coils in every resistance, with fast UK delivery.
Seven mesh resistances make up the Vaporesso GTX Replacement Coil range, each matched to a specific heating material, wattage range and vaping style.
Resistance sets the draw style and power band, guiding which Vaporesso GTX coil suits your device and e-liquid.
Which Vaporesso GTX Coil Resistance Suits Your Vaping Style?

Vaporesso GTX Coil resistance determines your draw style, from a tight mouth-to-lung inhale to an airy direct-to-lung inhale. Three vaping styles map across the resistance range, each pairing with a set wattage band and e-liquid type.
• MTL coils (0.8Ω to 1.2Ω) deliver a tight, cigarette-style draw at 7W to 16W, pairing best with 50/50 freebase and nic salt e-liquids.
• RDTL coils (0.4Ω to 0.6Ω) balance flavour and vapour at 20W to 32W, working well with both 50/50 and high-VG blends.
• DTL coils (0.15Ω to 0.3Ω) produce large clouds and intense flavour at 32W to 75W, performing best with high-VG 70+ e-liquids.
Coil resistance depends on device support too, because not every Vaporesso kit accepts the full GTX range.

column1: Which Vaporesso Devices Are Compatible With GTX Coils?
Vaporesso GTX Coils fit 10 devices across pod kits, tank kits and pen-style systems. Compatible resistances vary by device, so confirm your kit before choosing a coil.
GTX One and GTX Tank 18 exclude the 0.15Ω, 0.2Ω and 0.3Ω options, GTX Go 40 excludes the 0.15Ω and 0.2Ω coils, and Luxe PM40 accepts only the 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω and 1.2Ω mesh coils.
Who Should Use Vaporesso GTX Replacement Coils?
Vaporesso GTX vape Coils suit adult vapers who own a compatible Vaporesso kit and want to change draw style without buying a new device.
• Switch between MTL, RDTL and DTL vaping without changing your Vaporesso vape kit.
• Replace worn or burnt coils to restore fresh flavour and vapour.
• Match nic salt e-liquids with a tight 0.8Ω or 1.2Ω mouth-to-lung draw.
• Stock one coil platform that fits 10 Vaporesso devices.

Replace a Vaporesso GTX coil in under 2 minutes by removing the old coil, priming the new coil and refilling the pod or tank. Priming and a short saturation wait prevent dry hits and protect coil lifespan.
Remove the old coil. Detach the pod or tank, then unscrew or pull out the used GTX coil from the base and discard it.
Prime the new coil. Apply 3 to 5 drops of e-liquid onto the exposed cotton ports to saturate the wicking before first use.
Insert the new coil. Push or screw the new GTX coil into the base until it seats firmly and aligns correctly.
Fill the pod or tank. Reattach the pod or tank, then fill through the port and stay below the maximum line to prevent flooding.
Wait for saturation. Rest the coil for 5 to 10 minutes so the cotton absorbs e-liquid fully.
Start at low wattage. Begin at the lower end of the coil's wattage range, then raise the power gradually to your preferred balance.
Which devices are compatible with Vaporesso GTX Coils?

Vaporesso GTX Coils are compatible with 10 Vaporesso devices: GTX One, Target PM80, Target PM80 SE, Swag PX80, Gen Nano 80W, Xiron, GTX Go 40, Luxe PM40, GTX Tank 18 and GTX Tank 22. Compatible resistances vary by device, so check the compatibility table before buying a coil.
How long do Vaporesso GTX Coils last?

Vaporesso GTX Coils last 1 to 3 weeks, depending on e-liquid type, wattage, vaping frequency and priming quality. High-VG e-liquids and chain vaping shorten coil life, while moderate use with 50/50 blends extends it. Sweet, dark e-liquids coat the mesh faster and reduce lifespan.
Is a 0.15Ω or 0.2Ω Vaporesso GTX coil better?

The 0.15Ω coil produces bigger clouds and warmer vapour at 60W to 75W, while the 0.2Ω coil runs cooler at 45W to 60W with slightly longer coil life. Choose the 0.15Ω for maximum vapour, and choose the 0.2Ω for a balanced direct-to-lung draw.
What resistances are available in Vaporesso GTX Coils?

Vaporesso GTX Coils are available in 7 resistances: 0.15Ω, 0.2Ω, 0.3Ω, 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω and 1.2Ω. Lower resistances from 0.15Ω to 0.3Ω suit direct-to-lung vaping, and higher resistances from 0.8Ω to 1.2Ω suit mouth-to-lung vaping with nic salts.
What is the difference between GTX and GTX-2 Coils?

GTX-2 Coils add triple silicone o-rings for stronger leak resistance, while the mesh heating element and flax-cotton wicking stay identical to the original GTX coils. Performance, flavour and wattage ranges match across both versions. Confirm the exact GTX-2 resistances on the product listing before ordering.
Which e-liquids work best with Vaporesso GTX Coils?

DTL coils from 0.15Ω to 0.3Ω work best with high-VG 70+ e-liquids, RDTL coils from 0.4Ω to 0.6Ω suit 50/50 and high-VG blends, and MTL coils from 0.8Ω to 1.2Ω pair best with 50/50 freebase and nic salt e-liquids up to the UK legal 20mg/ml limit.

Vaporesso GTX Replacement Coils come in packs of 5, with all 5 coils sharing the same resistance. Select a single resistance at checkout to match your Vaporesso device and preferred vaping style, from a tight MTL draw to an airy DTL draw.

column1: How Powerful Is Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO Battery?

Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO contains a 2000mAh integrated battery, providing greater battery capacity within its compact KOKO chassis. The device delivers up to 35W output and supports USB Type-C charging at 5V/2.5A.

Uwell quotes a maximum battery duration of up to 10 days under its stated usage conditions. Actual time between charges varies with wattage, pod resistance, selected mode, puff duration and vaping frequency.
What Is the Difference Between Storm, Waves and Custom Modes?

Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO provides three output modes that change how power behaves during a puff. Storm targets a stronger sensation, Waves focuses on smooth flavour delivery, and Custom gives you greater control over different stages of the draw.
Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO uses a stepless airflow adjustment system. The slider moves continuously rather than restricting you to a small number of fixed airflow positions.

Closing the airflow produces a tighter draw suitable for MTL configurations, while opening it provides the increased airflow associated with RDL vaping. Pod resistance and airflow position work together to determine the final draw.
How Can You Customise Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO Interface?

Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO provides 5 user interface designs, eight languages and adjustable screen brightness. These settings allow you to change how information and animations appear on the 2-inch touchscreen.
The interface also includes an on-screen keyboard that lets you rename the device. This feature adds a personalisation option beyond conventional colour, theme and brightness controls.
Which Pods Fit Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO?

Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO supports Uwell's G-Pod platform, including compatible Caliburn G3 and GPP cartridges. The platform includes top-fill and side-fill pod designs, providing several cartridge formats and resistance options.
The kit contains a 0.4Ω GPP pod and a 0.6Ω GPP pod. Replacement options also extend to newer compatible GPP Alpha cartridges.

Uwell Caliburn pod platform provides resistance options for both RDL and MTL vaping. Lower-resistance cartridges support a more open RDL draw, while higher-resistance pods provide tighter MTL configurations.
Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO is available in 8 colour options. Every finish uses the same touchscreen interface, 2000mAh battery, 35W output and compatible G-Pod platform.

Can Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO use GPP Alpha and Caliburn G3 pods?

The stepless airflow slider provides continuous adjustment rather than limiting airflow to fixed positions. You can reduce airflow for a tighter MTL-style draw or increase airflow for a looser RDL configuration, depending on the installed pod.
Can you rename Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO?

Yes. Caliburn G4 Pro KOKO includes an on-screen keyboard that allows you to rename the device. Its customisation system also provides five interface designs, eight language options and adjustable screen brightness.

Uwell Caliburn G3 Lite Pod Kit FAQs
What makes Uwell Caliburn G3 Lite different from Caliburn G3?

Uwell Caliburn G3 Lite focuses on simplified operation with automatic draw activation and LED battery indicators rather than the G3’s OLED screen and adjustable controls. It also increases battery capacity to 1200mAh while retaining compatibility with Caliburn G3 pods.
Which Caliburn G3 pod is included with Uwell G3 Lite?

Caliburn G3 Lite includes a 0.9Ω FeCrAl meshed integrated-coil cartridge with a 2ml capacity and top-filling design. The 0.9Ω resistance provides a balanced option between tighter MTL and more open restricted vaping.
Can I use 0.6Ω and 1.2Ω pods with Uwell Caliburn G3 Lite?
Yes. Caliburn G3 Lite supports 0.6Ω, 0.9Ω and 1.2Ω Caliburn G3 cartridges. The 0.6Ω option supports a looser RDL draw, while the higher-resistance 1.2Ω cartridge provides tighter MTL vaping.
Can you see how much e-liquid is left in Caliburn G3 Lite?

Yes. Caliburn G3 Lite provides a transparent e-liquid viewing area around the cartridge, giving you a clear view of the remaining liquid. This allows you to check the 2ml pod without repeatedly removing it from the device.
Do Caliburn G3 Lite pods have replaceable coils?

No. Compatible Caliburn G3 cartridges contain integrated FeCrAl mesh coils, meaning the coil is permanently built into the pod. When the coil reaches the end of its usable life, you replace the complete cartridge rather than fitting a separate coil.
What is U2 structure in Caliburn G3 pods?

Caliburn G3 pod platform uses a U2 coil structure with ultrasonic welding and a U-shaped channel. These design elements improve e-liquid containment within the cartridge and work alongside the integrated mesh coil and Pro-FOCS flavour technology.

column1: Why Choose the Aspire Gotek X Pod Kit?
Aspire Gotek X for Switching from Disposables

Aspire Gotek X kit provides a familiar draw-activated, mouth-to-lung experience similar to disposable vapes, without the waste or ongoing cost. The 0.8Ω mesh coil produces discreet vapour and a cigarette-style throat hit that matches what disposable users expect from a transition device.

Refillable 2ml pods and a rechargeable 650mAh battery reduce running costs significantly compared to buying single-use devices. The Gotek X uses Aspire Gotek X replacement pods with built-in coils, meaning you swap the entire pod when flavour fades rather than handling separate coil changes.
Aspire Gotek X Adjustable Airflow for a Custom Draw

The airflow slider on the base of the Aspire Gotek X lets you fine-tune draw resistance in real time. Tighten the airflow for a warm, cigarette-style mouth-to-lung inhale with increased throat hit, or open the slider for a cooler restricted direct-to-lung draw with smoother vapour.

Adjustable airflow on a pod kit at this price point is uncommon. The Gotek X gives both tight-draw MTL vapers and slightly looser RDTL vapers a single device that adapts to their preferred style without needing a second kit.
Aspire Gotek X ASP Chipset Safety and Performance

Aspire's ASP chipset inside the Gotek X detects the resistance of the installed pod and calculates the optimal wattage automatically. The chipset delivers consistent power between 10W and 13W, ensuring stable flavour output across the battery's charge cycle.

Built-in protection features guard against overcharging, over-discharging, and short circuits. The ASP chipset makes the Aspire Gotek X a dependable choice for new vapers and experienced users who prioritise device safety alongside performance.
How to Set Up and Use the Aspire Gotek X
Setting up the Aspire Gotek X takes 3 steps before your first draw: charge the battery, fill the pod, and allow the coil to prime.
Follow the step-by-step instructions below for the best performance from your Gotek X kit.
Charge the battery. Connect the included USB-C cable to the charging port on the Aspire Gotek X. A full charge from empty takes under 1 hour. The LED indicator confirms charging status.
Remove the pod. Pull the Gotek X pod out of the device. The pod connects magnetically, so lift it straight upward with no tools required.

Fill the pod with e-liquid. Locate the silicone stopper on the side of the pod and pull it open to reveal the fill port. Add your chosen nic salt or 50/50 e-liquid through the port, then press the stopper firmly back into place.
Reinsert the pod. Place the filled pod back into the Aspire Gotek X device. The magnetic connection secures it in position.

Prime the coil. Leave the kit standing upright for 10 minutes before your first draw. Priming allows the e-liquid to saturate the mesh coil wicking material, preventing dry hits and extending pod life.

Inhale to vape. Draw on the mouthpiece to activate the Gotek X. The inhale sensor triggers the coil immediately with no buttons to press. Adjust the bottom airflow slider to set your preferred draw resistance.

FAQ's About The Aspire Gotek X Pod Kit
What is the Aspire Gotek X pod vape kit?

Aspire Gotek X is a compact, refillable pod vape kit with a 650mAh rechargeable battery, 0.8Ω mesh coil, and adjustable airflow. The Gotek X supports mouth-to-lung and restricted direct-to-lung vaping in a lightweight, matchbox-style design that weighs 52g.
Yes, the Aspire Gotek X contains a 650mAh rechargeable battery with USB-C fast charging. A full charge completes in under 1 hour. The USB-C charging cable is included in the box.
How long does the Aspire Gotek X battery last?
The 650mAh battery in the Aspire Gotek X lasts a full day for most moderate MTL vapers. Battery life varies depending on draw frequency, inhale duration, and airflow setting.
What e-liquid works best with the Aspire Gotek X?

The Aspire Gotek X works best with nic salt e-liquids and 50/50 PG/VG blends. The 0.8Ω mesh coil is designed for thinner e-liquids. High-VG liquids above a 50/50 ratio are not recommended because they wick poorly through the pod's coil.
Does the Aspire Gotek X have adjustable airflow?
Yes, the Aspire Gotek X features an adjustable bottom airflow slider. Tighten the airflow for a cigarette-style MTL draw, or loosen the slider for a smoother RDTL inhale with increased vapour.
What replacement pods does the Aspire Gotek X use?
The Aspire Gotek X uses Gotek refillable pods with a built-in 0.8Ω mesh coil. Each pod holds 2ml of e-liquid and features a side-fill design. When flavour quality drops, replace the entire pod.
Is the Aspire Gotek X compliant with UK vaping regulations?
Yes, the Aspire Gotek X uses a 2ml refillable pod that complies with UK TRPR regulations. The 2ml capacity meets the maximum tank size permitted under UK law for nicotine-containing e-liquid devices.
Can the Aspire Gotek X replace a disposable vape?

Yes, the Aspire Gotek X is a rechargeable, refillable alternative to single-use disposable vapes. The draw-activated MTL inhale, compact form factor, and 0.8Ω mesh coil replicate the experience of a disposable device while reducing cost and waste over time.

column1: Which Coil Resistance Suits Your Vaping Style?

Uwell Caliburn G3 pods 0.9 ohm and 1.2Ω options cover mouth-to-lung vaping, while the 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω pods handle Restricted Direct-to-Lung inhales. Pick the resistance that matches your preferred draw tightness, e-liquid type, and nicotine strength.

column1: Who Should Use the Uwell Caliburn G3 Refillable Pods?

Caliburn Uwell G3 pods suit vapers who own any device in the Caliburn G3 family and want a refill-and-vape system without separate coil changes. The four-resistance range covers both MTL and RDTL vaping styles for beginners through to experienced users.

• Nicotine salt vapers running 10mg or 20mg e-liquids in 50/50 VG/PG blends
• RDTL vapers wanting a warmer, airier inhale with lower-strength freebase juice
• Caliburn G3 Pro owners restocking Uwell Caliburn G3 Pro replacement pods for looser, higher-wattage draws
• Caliburn G3 Lite users buying Uwell Caliburn G3 Lite replacement pods for compact daily carry
How to Fill the Uwell Caliburn G3 Refillable Pods

Filling a Uwell Caliburn G3 pod takes under a minute. Detach the pod, open the fill port, add e-liquid, reseal the port, prime the coil, and take a few short priming puffs before your first full draw.
Remove the pod from the Caliburn G3 device by pulling straight up from the magnetic base.
Locate the fill port, either on the side of the pod behind a silicone stopper or under a snap-off top cap depending on the batch.
Insert the e-liquid nozzle into the fill port and dispense slowly along the inner wall to avoid air pockets.
Fill to the 2ml maximum line shown on the crystal-clear viewing window, leaving a small air gap at the top.
Reseal the fill port by pressing the silicone stopper flush or clicking the top cap back into place.
Prime the coil by resting the filled pod upright for five minutes so the wicking cotton saturates fully.
Reattach the pod to your device and take three short priming puffs before drawing normally.

column1: Uwell Crown X delivers up to 60W of variable power from its integrated 1500mAh battery. This higher output range works with the X coil platform to support both direct-to-lung and restricted-direct-to-lung vaping.
Variable wattage gives you direct control over power output rather than restricting the device to a single preset level. The appropriate setting depends on the installed coil and preferred draw.
What Does Boost Mode Do on Uwell Crown X?

Uwell Crown X Boost Mode is designed to maintain consistent power delivery as the remaining battery level decreases. This feature targets a more stable output rather than allowing vaping performance to decline noticeably as the battery discharges.
Actual vapour production and flavour can still vary with wattage, airflow, coil resistance, e-liquid and coil condition.
What Are the 3 Crown X Activation Modes?

Uwell Crown X provides three firing configurations: auto draw, button activation and combined operation. This system lets you choose whether inhaling, pressing the fire button or either action activates the device.
How Does Stepless Airflow Work on Uwell Crown X?

Uwell Crown X uses stepless airflow adjustment to provide continuous control over draw restriction. Rather than limiting airflow to several preset positions, the system lets you progressively increase or decrease incoming air.

A more open airflow supports DTL vaping, while reducing airflow creates the additional restriction associated with RDTL use. Coil resistance and wattage also influence the final vaping characteristics.
Which Coils Fit Uwell Crown X Vape Kit?
Uwell Crown X uses replaceable Uwell X mesh coils. Unlike integrated-coil cartridges, this system lets you retain the refillable pod and replace the coil separately when its performance declines.
The kit includes a 0.3Ω X coil pre-installed and a 0.6Ω X coil as a spare. These two resistances provide different options within the Crown X's DTL and RDTL operating range.

Uwell Crown X Pod Kit is available in 6 colour options. The range includes classic solid colours and distinctive multi-tone finishes, while every version provides the same 1500mAh battery, 60W maximum output, TFT display and Uwell X coil compatibility.

column1: How to Use the Uwell Crown X Pod Vape Kit
Install the Coil: Insert a compatible Uwell X coil into the Crown X pod if one is not already installed.
Prime the Coil: Apply e-liquid to accessible wicking material before using a new coil.
Fill the Pod: Open the snap-fit mouthpiece and fill the cartridge with suitable e-liquid without exceeding its 2ml capacity.
Allow Saturation: Leave a newly primed and filled coil for approximately 5–10 minutes before vaping.
Install the Pod: Attach the filled Crown X cartridge securely to the device.
Select Activation: Choose auto draw, fire-button activation or combined operation according to your preference.
Adjust Wattage: Set the output to an appropriate level for the installed X coil.
Adjust Airflow: Use the stepless airflow system to create your preferred DTL or RDTL draw.
Monitor the Display: Use the 0.96-inch TFT screen to check device information and settings.
Check E-Liquid: Monitor the remaining liquid through the clear-view window and refill before the coil becomes dry.
Replace the Coil: Install a fresh X coil when flavour or vapour production noticeably declines.
Recharge: Connect the supplied USB-C cable when the 1500mAh battery requires charging.
• 1 x Uwell Crown X Refillable Pod
What does Boost Mode do on Uwell Crown X?

Boost Mode is designed to maintain consistent output as the Crown X battery level decreases. This helps reduce noticeable power drop-off during discharge, although vapour and flavour can still change with coil condition, airflow, wattage and e-liquid.
What are the three firing options on Uwell Crown X?

Uwell Crown X supports auto draw, fire-button activation and a combined setting that enables both methods. You can therefore activate the device by inhaling, pressing the fire button or using either method when the combined configuration is selected.
What is the difference between the 0.3Ω and 0.6Ω Crown X coils?

The kit includes a 0.3Ω Uwell X mesh coil pre-installed and a 0.6Ω X mesh coil as a spare. Both operate within the Crown X's DTL and RDTL system, with wattage and stepless airflow providing additional control over the draw.
Does Uwell Crown X use replaceable coils or integrated-coil pods?

Uwell Crown X uses separately replaceable Uwell X coils inside its refillable 2ml pod. You can retain the cartridge and replace its coil when performance declines, unlike integrated-coil systems that require replacement of the complete pod.
How do you refill Uwell Crown X without removing the pod?

Uwell Crown X pod uses a snap-fit mouthpiece that provides access to its top-fill system while the cartridge remains installed. Its clear-view e-liquid window also lets you monitor the 2ml capacity and identify when another refill is required.
How long does a Uwell Crown X coil last?

The X coil platform is promoted with a potential lifespan of up to 30 days, but this is not a guaranteed replacement interval. Actual coil life depends on wattage, e-liquid composition, vaping frequency, puff duration and correct priming.

column1: What Is Different About Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE?

Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE is the leather-effect version of the standard G5 Lite. It retains the same 1600mAh battery, 35W maximum output, Smart Mode and draw-activated operating system while replacing the translucent-style exterior with a dual-tone leather-effect and striped texture.
The SE designation therefore focuses on exterior design rather than adding complicated controls. The device maintains the screen-free and button-free approach of the G5 Lite.
How Does Smart Mode Work on the Caliburn G5 Lite SE?
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE uses Smart Mode to detect the installed pod resistance and automatically match the power output. You do not need to select wattage manually before vaping.
Output scales according to the installed cartridge. Higher-resistance pods operate at lower power, meaning a 1.2Ω cartridge does not receive the device's full 35W maximum output.
Does Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE Have a Fire Button?
No. Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE operates exclusively through draw activation. Once a filled and primed cartridge is installed, inhaling through the mouthpiece activates the device automatically.
There are no firing buttons, mode-selection buttons or touchscreen menus to operate. Smart Mode handles power selection according to the detected cartridge resistance.
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE contains a 1600mAh integrated battery and supports up to 35W maximum output. USB-C connectivity provides rechargeable operation within the compact pod-system format.

Battery runtime varies according to cartridge resistance, puff duration and vaping frequency. Lower-resistance cartridges operating at higher power generally place greater demand on the battery than higher-resistance MTL options.
What Does the Four-Bar LED Indicator Show?
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE uses a four-bar gradient LED instead of a conventional display screen. The indicator communicates remaining battery status through green, blue, yellow and red illumination.
This visual system keeps battery information accessible while preserving the G5 Lite SE's minimalist screen-free design.
Which Pods Fit Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE?
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE supports the complete GPP cartridge platform from 0.4Ω to 1.2Ω. It also accepts compatible Caliburn G3 cartridges, expanding the available resistance and draw options.
The kit includes a 0.6Ω GPP cartridge intended for restricted RDL vaping.
Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE is available in 8 leather-effect colour options. Each version combines the Special Edition exterior with the same 1600mAh battery, Smart Mode and compatible pod platform.

Install the Pod: Insert the cartridge securely into the Caliburn G5 Lite SE.
Set the Airflow: Adjust the airflow control and rotate the cartridge if you want to change the airflow path.

Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE Vape Kit FAQs
Does Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE have buttons or a screen?

No. Caliburn G5 Lite SE has no fire button, touchscreen or conventional settings menu. Install a compatible filled pod and inhale through the mouthpiece to activate the device, while Smart Mode manages the appropriate output automatically.
Which GPP pod should I use with Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE?
The 0.4Ω and 0.6Ω GPP pods support RDL vaping, while 0.9Ω and 1.2Ω cartridges target MTL vaping. The included 0.6Ω GPP pod provides a restricted RDL configuration with a listed maximum output of 25W.
Can Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite SE use older Caliburn G3 pods?

Yes. G5 Lite SE supports compatible Caliburn G3 pods alongside the newer GPP cartridge platform. Listed G3 options include 0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω and 1.0Ω resistances, giving existing G3 pod users additional cartridge choices.
How do you adjust the airflow on Caliburn G5 Lite SE?

Uwell G5 Lite SE combines an adjustable airflow control with reversible pod positioning. You can adjust the airflow and rotate the installed cartridge 180 degrees to change its airflow path, creating different draw configurations with the same pod resistance.
What do PRO-FOCS 4.0 and U2 technology do in GPP pods?

PRO-FOCS 4.0 focuses on consistent flavour delivery, while U2 construction targets improved e-liquid containment within compatible GPP pods. The cartridges also use mesh coils, combining these technologies within the refillable pod system.
